advancements.guhs.barbecuether.ruilen.de: Trade a Wahoog Chonk Ingot with a Nether Mika
advancements.guhs.barbecuether.rookguh.d: Feed a Smoke Guh until it floats home, wahoog
advancements.guhs.barbecuether.mikakop.d: Get your paws on a Charred Mika Head
advancements.guhs.barbecuether.gloeister: Defeat Burnt Mika and grab the glowstar
advancements.guhs.barbecuether.knabbelba: Light a Nibble Beacon on a pyramid
advancements.guhs.barbecuether.asguh.des: Tame an Ash Guh in the Ash Vale
advancements.guhs.guhmension.find_diepe_: Find a Deep Guh Sea in the Guhmension
advancements.guhs.knuffeldal.root.title: Snuggledale
advancements.guhs.knuffeldal.root.descri: Cozy, sweet and guh-tastic: step into the Guhmension
advancements.guhs.knuffeldal.bezocht.des: Walk on Snuggledale's pink snuggle grass
advancements.guhs.knuffeldal.stadje.desc: Find the town in the middle of Snuggledale
advancements.guhs.knuffeldal.burgemeeste: Talk to Mayor Chonkworth on his front steps
advancements.guhs.knuffeldal.kruimel_mik: Lure a Crumb Mika away from its loot with a treat
advancements.guhs.knuffeldal.knusfeest_k: Bring all six party chores and celebrate at the party buffet
advancements.guhs.knuffeldal.knuffelburg: Become the Snuggle Mayor of Snuggledale. WAHOOG!
advancements.guhs.knuffeldal.seizoen_all: Fill the Season Scrapbook: two things in every season
advancements.guhs.knuffeldal.cocotje.des: Help Coco find what she lost
gui.guhs.knus.binnenkort_lang: More cozy is coming here soon! Nyeg, just a little more patience...
gui.guhs.knus.kies: Click a section to see its milestones and collections
gui.guhs.knus.klik_item: Click a picture (or hover over it) to read what it is.
gui.guhs.knus.nog_niet: ??? Not discovered yet. Nyeg, keep looking!
gui.guhs.knus.mijlpaal_bereikt: Cozy milestone: %s! Claim your reward in your Guhdex (Cozy tab). WAHOOG!
quest.guhs.knus.binnenkort: Nyeg, I'm not quite ready yet! Come back soon, I'll have something super cozy for you. Wahoog!
gui.guhs.knus.mijlpaal.seizoenen_bladerh: Jumped into a leaf pile ten times
gui.guhs.knus.knuffelvriendjes.burgemees: The mayor of Snuggledale. He loves parties, lists and his chain of office. Mostly parties.
gui.guhs.knus.knuffelvriendjes.cocotje.i: OH YEAH THEY HANG ON MY CHONK. 'Cause you so wahoog. Nyeg.
gui.guhs.knus.knuffelvriendjes.opa_guh.i: Sits on his bench by the campfire and knows everything about the old days. The VERY old days.
gui.guhs.knus.seizoensplakboek.lente_kra: In spring the season planters bloom. Three flowers on top: a blossom wreath!
gui.guhs.knus.seizoensplakboek.lente_guh: A guh with a blossom wreath
Your tame guh wore a blossom wreath in spring. So sweet, WAHOOG!
gui.guhs.knus.seizoensplakboek.zomer_hoe: In summer the planters are full of sunflowers. Three wheat on top: a straw sun hat!
gui.guhs.knus.seizoensplakboek.zomer_guh: A guh with a sun hat
Your tame guh kept their snoot out of the sun with a sun hat. Lovely and chonky.
gui.guhs.knus.seizoensplakboek.herfst_ho: In fall the leaf piles grow big and soft. Jump in from a little height: wheeeee!
gui.guhs.knus.seizoensplakboek.herfst_gu: In the leaves with your guh
Your tame guh jumped into the leaf pile with you and had a good roll through it.
gui.guhs.knus.seizoensplakboek.winter_sn: Two snow blocks stacked, a snowguh head on top: a Snowman Guh! (Counts in winter.)
gui.guhs.knus.seizoensplakboek.winter_gu: Your tame guh wore a cozy little scarf in winter. Warm and wahoog.
gui.guhs.seizoen.sneeuwpop: A snowman guh! He looks at you super happily.
gui.guhs.seizoen.tip.lente: Spring! Put three flowers on the season planter for a blossom wreath.
gui.guhs.seizoen.tip.zomer: Summer! Put three wheat on the season planter for a straw sun hat.
gui.guhs.seizoen.tip.herfst: Fall! Jump into the leaf piles. Four leaves on the season planter: leaf piles for at home.
gui.guhs.seizoen.tip.winter: Winter! Three wool: a cozy scarf. Three snowballs: a Snowguh Head.
gui.guhs.knusfeest.stap.gemaakt: done, bring it to the mayor!
gui.guhs.knusfeest.stap.gestolen: stolen by a Crumb Mika! Follow the crumbs...
gui.guhs.knusfeest.lijst_klaar: There are no party chores right now. Come back to Mayor Chonkworth next season!
gui.guhs.knusfeest.lijst_leeg: The list is still empty. Talk to Mayor Chonkworth on the square in Snuggledale first.
gui.guhs.knusfeest.hint: Point at a task: where do you get it?  ! = with you  ? = stolen
quest.guhs.burgemeester.start: Ahem! Welcome, welcome to Snuggledale! I'm Mayor Chonkworth. The Great Cozyfest is coming up... and NOTHING is ready! No cake, no tea, no garlands, nyeg! Will you help? Here's my list of six party chores. And watch out for the Crumb Mikas: they snatch everything!
quest.guhs.burgemeester.lijst: Look, this is what's still on the list. Bring everything here and I'll tick it off. Ahem, WAHOOG!
quest.guhs.burgemeester.hoi: Ah, there you are again! How are the party chores going? Let's see what you've got.
quest.guhs.burgemeester.hoi_collega: Ahem! Fellow Snuggle Mayor! How lovely. How are the party chores going?
quest.guhs.burgemeester.dank: Oh, WAHOOG! Thank you! Another party chore off the list. The Cozyfest is going to be so cozy!
quest.guhs.burgemeester.niets: Nyeg, you don't have anything for the party yet. Check the list to see what's still needed.
quest.guhs.burgemeester.alles: It's all here! The cake, the tea, the hairdos, the garlands, the flowers and the lanterns! So... now it's time for... THE GREAT COZYFEST! Everyone to the party buffet! Bring your guhs!
quest.guhs.burgemeester.alles_seizoen: It's all here! Now let's celebrate the season party. Everyone to the buffet! WAHOOG!
quest.guhs.burgemeester.klaar.0: What a party that was. My tummy is still full. Come back next season and we'll celebrate again!
quest.guhs.burgemeester.klaar.1: Ahem. As mayor, I must say: this is the coziest dale in the whole Guhmension. Thanks to you!
quest.guhs.burgemeester.klaar.2: Have you ever listened to Grandpa Guh at the campfire? He tells the most wonderful stories. Sometimes he falls asleep halfway through, nyeg.
quest.guhs.burgemeester.seizoen.lente: It's spring! Time for the spring party! I've put a few new party chores on my list. Will you help again?
quest.guhs.burgemeester.seizoen.zomer: It's summer! The summer party is coming, and I have another list. Sun hats on and let's get to work, WAHOOG!
quest.guhs.burgemeester.seizoen.herfst: It's fall! I have a few party chores for the fall party. Jumping into the leaf piles in between is allowed!
quest.guhs.burgemeester.seizoen.winter: It's winter! The winter party will be the coziest party of the year. Will you help with my list?
quest.guhs.burgemeester.teruggevonden: Ahem! I found your %s by the fountain. That Crumb Mika left it lying there. Ticked off!
quest.guhs.cocotje.vraag: DO YOU KNOW WHERE THEY ARE??????
quest.guhs.cocotje.optie.2: I can see them hanging on you, Coco
quest.guhs.cocotje.antwoord.1: Nyeg good luck. I'll chonk it out if u know something
quest.guhs.cocotje.antwoord.2: OH YEAH THEY HANG ON MY CHONK
quest.guhs.cocotje.lief.1: they still hang on my chonk. nyeg.
quest.guhs.knuffeldal.bewoner.knabbel: Nom, a cheese nibble! Thank you! But I can't come with you, I live here. Nyeg.
gui.guhs.knuffeldal.beschermd: Nyeg! Snuggledale is so cozy, nothing here can change.
gui.guhs.knuffeldal.welkom: Welcome to Snuggledale! Mayor Chonkworth is standing on his steps in the square. WAHOOG!
gui.guhs.knuffeldal.titel_gekregen: %s is now Snuggle Mayor of Snuggledale! WAHOOG!
gui.guhs.knuffeldal.oorkonde: For the Snuggle Mayor, with thanks from all of Snuggledale. WAHOOG!
gui.guhs.knuffeldal.seizoensfeest_klaar: What a cozy season party! Mayor Chonkworth waves you goodbye. See you next season!
gui.guhs.knuffeldal.buffet.gedekt: The buffet is set! Put something yummy on it: pastries, harvest, tea, cheese milk or cheese nibbles.
gui.guhs.knuffeldal.buffet.leeg: A party buffet table. During a Cozyfest it's full of yummy treats!
gui.guhs.knuffeldal.buffet.zelfgemaakt: Homemade! %s is on the buffet now. The guhs look at it all chonky.
gui.guhs.knuffeldal.buffet.erop: %s is on the buffet now. Nom!
gui.guhs.knuffeldal.feest.groot: THE GREAT COZYFEST! All the guhs are coming to the party buffet. Put something yummy on it yourself, too!
gui.guhs.knuffeldal.feest.seizoen: The season party begins! The guhs are coming to feast at the party buffet.
gui.guhs.knuffeldal.feest.einde: The party is over. Everyone is full, chonky and very, very wahoog.
gui.guhs.kruimel_mika.gestolen: *giggle* A Crumb Mika snatches your %s and runs off! Follow the crumbs...
gui.guhs.kruimel_mika.gelokt: The Crumb Mika sniffs at your treat... he forgets all about his loot! Give him the treat (right-click).
gui.guhs.kruimel_mika.zonder: *giggle* No treat, no loot, nyeg! (cheese nibbles or pastries)
gui.guhs.kruimel_mika.terug: The Crumb Mika gobbles up your treat and lets go of your %s! He runs off giggling.
gui.guhs.kruimel_mika.niet_meppen: Nyeg, no whacking! You lure Crumb Mikas away with a treat.
gui.guhs.evenement.start.knusfeest: It's Cozyfest! Everyone to the party buffet, with all your guhs!
gui.guhs.superkompas.knus.tooltip: Cozy little spots: Snuggledale, the farm, the observatory, the balloon festival...
structure.guhs.knuffeldal_stadje.tooltip: The cozy town in the middle of Snuggledale: Mayor Chonkworth, the Great Cozyfest, Coco...
block.guhs.pluisgras.lore: Soft pink fluff. Every now and then a little puff floats off.
item.guhs.pluisgras.lore: Soft pink fluff. Every now and then a little puff floats off.

item.guhs.pluizenboom_zaailing.lore: Grows into a fluffy pink tree
block.guhs.guhpaddenstoel.lore: Bone meal on it: a giant guh mushroom!
item.guhs.guhpaddenstoel.lore: Bone meal on it: a giant guh mushroom!
block.guhs.feestbuffettafel.lore: During a Cozyfest it's full of yummy treats
item.guhs.feestbuffettafel.lore: During a Cozyfest it's full of yummy treats
block.guhs.seizoensbloembak.lore: Blooms along with the seasons. Right-click: what can you do with it now?
item.guhs.seizoensbloembak.lore: Blooms along with the seasons. Right-click: what can you do with it now?
block.guhs.knus_oorkonde.lore: For the Snuggle Mayor of Snuggledale
item.guhs.knus_oorkonde.lore: For the Snuggle Mayor of Snuggledale
item.guhs.knusfeestlijstje.lore: Right-click: which party chores are still open?
item.guhs.sneeuwguhkopje.lore: Put me on two snow blocks!
item.guhs.sneeuwguhkopje.hoe: Put the snowguh head on top of two snow blocks and you've got a snowman guh!
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.pluisguh: An extra fluffy pink guh with a fluffy tuft and fluffy cheeks. Lives only in Snuggledale and would just love to be cuddled. Tame him with cheese nibbles!
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.burgemeesterguh: Mayor Chonkworth, with a top hat and a golden chain of office. Organizes the Great Cozyfest and then a season party every season. Ahem!
gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.kruimel_mika: Rarity: Sneaky (only when they're snatching something)
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.kruimel_mika: A little Mika covered in cookie crumbs. Never fights, only snatches: party cakes, tea sets, garlands... Lure him away with a treat and he runs off giggling.
gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.cocotje: Rarity: Unique (in her little house in Snuggledale)
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.cocotje: Coco is always losing something. They hang on her chonk. Nyeg.
gui.guhs.seizoen.wissel.lente: The Guhmension is blooming: it's SPRING! The planters in Snuggledale are full of blossoms. WAHOOG!
gui.guhs.seizoen.wissel.zomer: The sun is shining all chonky: it's SUMMER! Time for sun hats in Snuggledale.
gui.guhs.seizoen.wissel.herfst: The leaves are falling: it's FALL! The leaf piles in Snuggledale are big again. Jump in!
gui.guhs.seizoen.wissel.winter: Brrr, it's WINTER! Scarves on and build snowman guhs. Nyeg, so cold!
gui.guhs.knusfeest.waar.feesttaart: Baker Crusty bakes it in the Nibble Bakery, on the north side of the square.
gui.guhs.knusfeest.waar.theeservies: Mrs. Teaspoon lends it out after a snug tea party in the Nibble Tea House (east side).
gui.guhs.knusfeest.waar.feestkapsels: Curly the Barber styles them during a festive salon show at Snip & Chonk (south side).
gui.guhs.knusfeest.waar.feestslingers: Miss Snuggles' baby guhs craft them at the Snuggle Daycare (west side).
gui.guhs.knusfeest.waar.feestbloemen: Grow guh flowers in your own garden patch and make a party bouquet.
gui.guhs.knusfeest.waar.sterrenlantaarns: Professor Twinkle gives them to you when you connect a constellation at the Guh Observatory.
gui.guhs.knus.knuffelvriendjes.pluisje.i: Hi! I'm Fluffy. My house has the fluffiest ears in all of Snuggledale. WAHOOG!
quest.guhs.knuffeldal.bewoner.pluisje.0: Hi! I'm Fluffy. My house has the fluffiest ears in all of Snuggledale. WAHOOG!
quest.guhs.knuffeldal.bewoner.pluisje.1: Know what I love most? Jumping into a leaf pile. Wheeee! But you can only do that in the fall, nyeg.
quest.guhs.knuffeldal.bewoner.pluisje.2: My fur is so fluffy, sometimes I lose a bit of fluff. See them floating? Those are mine.
gui.guhs.knus.knuffelvriendjes.knabbeltj: I'm Nibbles and I can smell cheese nibbles from waaay far away. Got one on you, by any chance? Nyeg?
quest.guhs.knuffeldal.bewoner.knabbeltje: I'm Nibbles and I can smell cheese nibbles from waaay far away. Got one on you, by any chance? Nyeg?
My roof is yellow, just like a cheese nibble. So I wake up chonky every morning.
Those Crumb Mikas sometimes snatch our nibbles, nyeg! Then we're not wahoog enough.
gui.guhs.knus.knuffelvriendjes.dikkie.in: Hello, I'm Chubbs. I'm not too chonky, you know. You can never be too chonky! Just not wahoog enough.
quest.guhs.knuffeldal.bewoner.dikkie.0: Hello, I'm Chubbs. I'm not too chonky, you know. You can never be too chonky! Just not wahoog enough.
quest.guhs.knuffeldal.bewoner.dikkie.1: At the party buffet I'm always first. And last. WAHOOG!
quest.guhs.knuffeldal.bewoner.dikkie.2: I have a chonkbag at the top of my house. I sink into it so nice and chonky...
gui.guhs.knus.knuffelvriendjes.mollie.in: Hi hi, I'm Molly! I'm a little shy... but you're welcome to stay a while.
quest.guhs.knuffeldal.bewoner.mollie.0: Hi hi, I'm Molly! I'm a little shy... but you're welcome to stay a while.
quest.guhs.knuffeldal.bewoner.mollie.1: Shall we watch the fountain together? That big guh head spits water, hee hee.
quest.guhs.knuffeldal.bewoner.mollie.2: In spring I braid blossom wreaths by the planters. You try too, with three little flowers!
I'm Freckles, the littlest in the dale! But my ears are HUGE. Nyeg.
quest.guhs.knuffeldal.bewoner.sproetje.0: I'm Freckles, the smallest in the dale! But my ears are HUGE. Nyeg.
quest.guhs.knuffeldal.bewoner.sproetje.1: Grandpa Guh tells stories at the campfire in the evening. About Mikas and cheese nibbles. So exciting!
quest.guhs.knuffeldal.bewoner.sproetje.2: When I grow up I'm going to be mayor. Or a baker. Or both! WAHOOG!
I'm Dumpling, I live next to the playground. Slide! Swing! Climbing dome! WAHOOG!
quest.guhs.knuffeldal.bewoner.bolletje.0: I'm Dumpling, I live next to the playground. Slide! Swing! Climbing dome! WAHOOG!
quest.guhs.knuffeldal.bewoner.bolletje.1: In winter I build snowman guhs: two snow blocks, a little snowguh head on top, done!
quest.guhs.knuffeldal.bewoner.bolletje.2: Sometimes I get so tired from playing that I just fall asleep in the sand. Zzz... nyeg.
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.bakkerguh: Baker Crusty has baked cheese nibble bread his whole life, and he's started to look a bit like it: golden brown and always covered in flour. Help him with the orders and every guh in the dale gets nice and WAHOOG again.
item.guhs.feesttaart.lore: Three layers of chonky happiness, in a pink box with a bow
item.guhs.feesttaart.lore2: For Mayor Chonkworth and the Great Cozyfest. No eating it on the way, nyeg!
item.guhs.knabbelbroodje.lore: Crunchy bun with nibble crumbs. Makes you speedy!
item.guhs.knabbelbroodje.njam: Nom! Nibble zoom: you run like a hungry guh!
item.guhs.kaaskrakeling.lore: A twisted pretzel of cheese dough with sugar. Quick little hands!
item.guhs.kaaskrakeling.njam: Crunchity-crunch! Your little hands are suddenly speedy.
item.guhs.vadsvlaai.lore: A whole cheese pie. Chonky? Nah: just WAHOOG.
item.guhs.vadsvlaai.njam: Mmm, chonk pie! An extra layer of cuddle padding for when things get rough.
item.guhs.guhcroissant.lore: A crescent of puff pastry with cheese. It gives you sweet little looks.
item.guhs.guhcroissant.njam: Boing! A guhcroissant makes you all bouncy.
item.guhs.knabbelkoekje.lore: A little cookie for in between. Quick to eat, quick to go!
item.guhs.knabbelkoekje.njam: Crumble crumble... and off you go, full speed!
item.guhs.kaasbolletje.lore: A soft roll with melted cheese. Patches you right up.
item.guhs.kaasbolletje.njam: Warm and cheesy... you feel better right away, nyeg.
item.guhs.pluismuffin.lore: So fluffy you gently float away.
item.guhs.pluismuffin.njam: Fluff! You feel light as a little cloud.
item.guhs.theetaartje.lore: With a pink heart and powdered sugar. Brings luck (and a craving for tea).
item.guhs.theetaartje.njam: What a sweet little tart. Today's going to be a lucky day!
item.guhs.knabbeltompouce.lore: Pink icing, yellow cream, two crunchy layers. Strong stuff!
item.guhs.knabbeltompouce.njam: Splat, cream on your snoot! You feel strong as a guh castle.
item.guhs.vadsdonut.lore: A little ring with pink icing and sprinkles. Boing boing!
item.guhs.vadsdonut.njam: Sprinkles! Your legs want to jump!
item.guhs.guhwafel.lore: A round waffle with sugar. Helps you hold your breath underwater for ages.
item.guhs.guhwafel.njam: Waffle bubbles! Now you can nibble underwater for ages.
item.guhs.sterrenkoekje.lore: A little star with pink icing: you can see everything at night with it.
item.guhs.sterrenkoekje.njam: Twinkle twinkle! Your eyes can see in the dark.
gui.guhs.bakkerij.voor_klant: That's for a customer! Right-click the customer to hand it over.
gui.guhs.bakkerij.voor_klant.tooltip: For one of Baker Crusty's customers
gui.guhs.bakkerij.vers: With fresh stuff from Snuggledale (farm and gardens) you bake one extra!
gui.guhs.bakkerij.wordt.nieuw: A new recipe?! Give it a try!
gui.guhs.bakkerij.wordt.feesttaart: This will be: the PARTY CAKE!
gui.guhs.bakkerij.wordt.geheim: Hmm... that looks like Crusty's secret recipe.
gui.guhs.bakkerij.geheim: Only Baker Crusty bakes the Party Cake recipe, for the Great Cozyfest.
gui.guhs.bakkerij.spatie: Space or OUT! when the needle is in the orange
gui.guhs.bakkerij.uitleg: Pick dough, shape and topping and slide it into the oven
gui.guhs.bakkerij.bakt: %s is in the oven... watch the needle!
gui.guhs.bakkerij.uit.spel: %s is ready (%s)! Quick, to the customer!
gui.guhs.bakkerij.geen_bestellingen: No customers yet... they're on their way!
gui.guhs.bakkerij.te_ver: You're too far from the oven.
gui.guhs.bakkerij.al_bezig: There's already something in the oven!
gui.guhs.bakkerij.te_weinig: You don't have enough ingredients for this recipe.
gui.guhs.bakkerij.andere_oven: Use the ovens of the bakery where you're playing!
gui.guhs.bakkerij.vergeten: You forgot about the oven... burnt, nyeg!
gui.guhs.bakkerij.play.tooltip: For two whole minutes you're the baker: help the customers get their orders
gui.guhs.bakkerij.shop.tooltip: Baker's outfit, your own Nibble Oven and baking things, for Bake Coins
gui.guhs.bakkerij.rules: Customers come in with a little cloud over their heads: that's what they want. Click a Nibble Oven, pick dough, shape and topping (or click an order), slide it into the oven and take it out when the needle is in the orange. Then right-click the customer! Three happy customers in a row: combo! Bake Coins buy you fun stuff.
gui.guhs.bakkerij.busy: %s is baking right now (%s seconds left, %s points). Come watch!
gui.guhs.bakkerij.first: The first time you get extra Bake Coins. WAHOOG!
gui.guhs.bakkerij.free: The ovens are warm. Ready to bake?
gui.guhs.bakkerij.feest: Cozyfest! Score %s points and a party customer will come in for the PARTY CAKE.
quest.guhs.bakkerij.hello: Good morning! I'm Baker Crusty. The Mikas snatched my cheese nibbles again, and now the guhs in the dale aren't WAHOOG enough anymore... Will you help me with the orders?
quest.guhs.bakkerij.hello.feest: The Great Cozyfest! The mayor wants a party cake, and I only bake that for a real baker. Show me what you've got!
quest.guhs.bakkerij.busy: Shh, baking in progress! Your turn soon.
quest.guhs.bakkerij.busy_you: You're baking! The customers are waiting, chonk!
quest.guhs.bakkerij.elsewhere: You're already baking somewhere else. One bakery at a time!
quest.guhs.bakkerij.broken: Nyeg... my bakery is all muddled, I can't find my ovens.
quest.guhs.bakkerij.shop: My little shop! I only sell the baker outfit here. Nom!
quest.guhs.bakkerij.go: Apron on, pawsies washed? Click a nibble oven to bake, and give the customer what they want. Ready...?
quest.guhs.bakkerij.go.feest: Apron on! First get %s points, then the party customer comes for the party cake. Ready...?
quest.guhs.bakkerij.invite1: Warm buns! Come help me bake?
quest.guhs.bakkerij.invite2: The customers can't wait... nyeg nyeg!
quest.guhs.bakkerij.invite3: Who wants to be a baker? Come talk to me!
quest.guhs.bakkerij.cheer.start: Here come the customers! Chonk chonk chonk!
quest.guhs.bakkerij.cheer.half: One minute left! Keep baking, little baker!
quest.guhs.bakkerij.cheer.ten: Ten seconds left! Quick quick quick!
quest.guhs.bakkerij.cheer.feest: Look, the party customer is here! Bake the PARTY CAKE: sweet dough, tart, pink icing!
quest.guhs.bakkerij.bar: %s points · %s s left · combo x%s · %s happy customers
quest.guhs.bakkerij.vol: Your pockets are full! Give some to the customers first.
quest.guhs.bakkerij.aangebrand: Burnt! Your combo is gone... nyeg.
quest.guhs.bakkerij.verkeerd: That's not what they ordered! Combo gone.
quest.guhs.bakkerij.gemist: A customer waited too long. Combo gone.
quest.guhs.bakkerij.feesttaart: Baker Crusty wraps up a real party cake for you: bring it to Mayor Chonkworth! Watch out for Crumb Mikas...
quest.guhs.bakkerij.done: Done! %s points, %s happy customers, %s baked perfectly, best combo %s.
quest.guhs.bakkerij.first: Your first time baking! Here, %s extra Bake Coins. WAHOOG!
quest.guhs.bakkerij.end.super: What a baker! The whole dale is WAHOOG again. Coming back tomorrow?
quest.guhs.bakkerij.end.good: Nicely baked, chonk! The customers are munching away.
quest.guhs.bakkerij.end.ok: That went pretty well! Even faster next time, nyeg.
quest.guhs.bakkerij.stopped: Baking stopped (%s points). The customers are going home.
quest.guhs.bakkerij.klant.feestwens: I'm here for the %s! Sweet dough, tart, pink icing... for the Cozyfest!
quest.guhs.bakkerij.klant.blij2: Nom nom, a %s! Now I'm WAHOOG again.
quest.guhs.bakkerij.klant.blij3: Just what I wanted, a %s! Nyeg!
quest.guhs.bakkerij.klant.blij4: A %s, all for me! How chonky sweet!
quest.guhs.bakkerij.klant.weg: I have to go home... maybe tomorrow, nyeg.
quest.guhs.bakkerij.klant.niet_jij: You're not my baker, nyeg. I'm waiting for Crusty's helper.
advancements.guhs.knuffeldal.bakkerij_ee: Help a customer at the Nibble Bakery with their order
advancements.guhs.knuffeldal.bakkerij_co: Make six customers in a row happy at Baker Crusty's
advancements.guhs.knuffeldal.bakkerij_re: Bake all twelve recipes from the Recipe Book
gui.guhs.knus.receptenboek.knabbelbroodj: Nibble Dough + Roll + Nibble Crumbs. Baker Crusty's very first recipe: early in the morning the whole dale smells of it.
gui.guhs.knus.receptenboek.kaaskrakeling: Cheese Dough + Braid + Powdered Sugar. Crusty braids them with his ears. Honest, nyeg.
gui.guhs.knus.receptenboek.vadsvlaai.inf: Sweet Dough + Tart + Cheese. For when you're not WAHOOG enough: a whole pie full of cheese.
Puff Pastry + Crescent + Cheese. It looks at you so sweetly you hardly dare to eat it. Hardly.
gui.guhs.knus.receptenboek.knabbelkoekje: Nibble Dough + Disc + Powdered Sugar. Small and quick: a cookie for the road.
Cheese Dough + Roll + Cheese. Soft, warm and cheesy. Guhs call it 'a cuddle you can eat'.
gui.guhs.knus.receptenboek.pluismuffin.i: Sweet Dough + Roll + Pink Icing. With two little icing ears. So fluffy you float away.
gui.guhs.knus.receptenboek.theetaartje.i: Puff Pastry + Tart + Powdered Sugar. Mrs. Teaspoon orders three every day, to go with her tea.
gui.guhs.knus.receptenboek.knabbeltompou: Puff Pastry + Disc + Pink Icing. Pink icing, yellow cream: nobody eats one without making a mess.
gui.guhs.knus.receptenboek.vadsdonut.inf: Sweet Dough + Ring + Pink Icing. With rainbow sprinkles. Every baby guh's favorite.
gui.guhs.knus.receptenboek.guhwafel.info: Sweet Dough + Disc + Powdered Sugar. A round waffle. Merguhs take it down to the bottom of the sea.
gui.guhs.knus.receptenboek.sterrenkoekje: Nibble Dough + Star + Pink Icing. Baked by starlight. Professor Twinkle swears by them.
advancements.guhs.knuffeldal.creche_inge: At the Snuggle Daycare, give three baby guhs a bottle and a clean diaper, tuck them in and sing a lullaby
advancements.guhs.knuffeldal.creche_alle: In one game, bring at least 8 baby guhs back to their cradle without Miss Snuggles having to fetch a single one herself
advancements.guhs.knuffeldal.creche_slaa: Sing all four of Miss Snuggles' lullabies. Zzz... WAHOOG! (softly)
block.guhs.guh_wiegje.lore: A cradle with a little guh face. Right-click to rock it: baby guhs nearby grow a little.
item.guhs.guh_wiegje.lore: A cradle with a little guh face. Right-click to rock it: baby guhs nearby grow a little.
block.guhs.speelkleed.lore: A soft play mat with a smiling guh. For crawling on!
item.guhs.speelkleed.lore: A soft play mat with a smiling guh. For crawling on!
block.guhs.feestslingers.lore: Crafted by the baby guhs of the Snuggle Daycare. For the Great Cozyfest!
item.guhs.feestslingers.lore: Crafted by the baby guhs of the Snuggle Daycare. For the Great Cozyfest!
item.guhs.speenmunt.lore: The coin of the Snuggle Daycare. Spend it at Miss Snuggles (and in the claw machine).
item.guhs.babyflesje.lore: Warm cheese milk for baby guhs. Your own baby guh grows a little from it too. Slurp!
item.guhs.schone_luier.lore: Fresh and soft. Baby guhs get sooo wahoog from it!
item.guhs.knuffeldekentje.lore: A soft little blanket of fluff wool. Tuck a baby guh in with it: zzz...
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.juf_knuffel: Looks after all the baby guhs of Snuggledale. She knows four lullabies and always has a little bottle of cheese milk in her apron. Baby guhs crawl off everywhere: will you help them back into their cradles?
quest.guhs.juf_knuffel.hoi.0: Shh, shh... hello! The baby guhs are sleeping. Well, almost all of them. Nyeg.
quest.guhs.juf_knuffel.hoi.1: Welcome to the Snuggle Daycare! Will you help me? Baby guhs are very sweet, but also very crawly.
quest.guhs.juf_knuffel.hoi.2: Hi! Did you know baby guhs can never be too chonky? They just need to become WAHOOG. That's what I help them with.
quest.guhs.juf_knuffel.bezig: One moment please, I'm helping someone else with the baby guhs right now. Zzz... shh!
quest.guhs.juf_knuffel.bezig_jij: You're already busy! Look at the cradles: they show what the baby guhs want.
quest.guhs.juf_knuffel.geen_wiegjes: Nyeg, where did my cradles go? Without cradles we can't do anything.
quest.guhs.juf_knuffel.verzorgen: Look, three baby guhs are awake! Above their cradle you can see what they want: first a bottle, then a clean diaper, then tucking in with a blankie, and then a lullaby. Here, take this!
quest.guhs.juf_knuffel.verzorgen_feest: The Great Cozyfest! The baby guhs want to make party garlands. Give them paper first, then a bottle, a clean diaper, the blankie and a lullaby. Here, take this!
quest.guhs.juf_knuffel.liedje_vandaag: Today we're singing: %s. Right-click the cradle when the baby guh wants a music note.
quest.guhs.juf_knuffel.liedje_opnieuw: Almost! %s of the %s notes right. One more time, nice and calm... just right-click the cradle.
quest.guhs.juf_knuffel.liedje_geleerd: Ooooh, that sounded lovely! You now know the song %s. It's in your Guhdex (Cozy).
quest.guhs.juf_knuffel.verzorgd: All three are asleep! Zzz... how cozy. Here, %s Pacifier Coins. Thank you!
quest.guhs.juf_knuffel.slingers: And look what the baby guhs made for the party: party garlands! Bring them to Mayor Chonkworth.
quest.guhs.juf_knuffel.terugbrengen: Oopsie, the baby guhs are waking up and crawling everywhere! Right-click a baby guh to pick it up and bring it back to an empty cradle. Quick, but gently!
quest.guhs.juf_knuffel.eerste_spel: So good for a first time! Here are %s extra Pacifier Coins, as a welcome.
quest.guhs.juf_knuffel.gestopt: Okay, then I'll put them back myself. Zzz...
quest.guhs.juf_knuffel.te_lang: Nyeg, it took so long that I tucked them in myself. Will you come back later?
gui.guhs.creche.knop.verzorgen.tooltip: Nice and calm: give three baby guhs a bottle and a diaper, tuck them in and sing a lullaby
gui.guhs.creche.knop.knutselen.tooltip: For the Great Cozyfest: the baby guhs craft party garlands, then it's the care round
gui.guhs.creche.knop.terugbrengen.toolti: The game: the baby guhs crawl away, bring them back to their cradles quick!
gui.guhs.creche.knop.stop.tooltip: Miss Snuggles takes over (in the game you still get your points)
gui.guhs.creche.knop.winkel.tooltip: Baby clothes, cradles and blankies for Pacifier Coins
gui.guhs.creche.scherm.uitleg: This is the Snuggle Daycare! Will you help me? Calm caring: bottle, diaper, blankie and a lullaby. Or the game: the baby guhs crawl away, bring them back to their cradles!
gui.guhs.creche.scherm.feest: The Great Cozyfest! The baby guhs want to craft party garlands for the mayor. Will you join the care round? Then they'll do their crafting first.
gui.guhs.creche.scherm.bezig: %s is helping me with the baby guhs right now. Just a moment, shh!
gui.guhs.creche.scherm.jij_verzorgen: You're doing the care round. Look above the cradles to see what the baby guhs want.
gui.guhs.creche.scherm.jij_terugbrengen: You're bringing them back! Quick, there goes one!
gui.guhs.creche.scherm.geen_best: No record yet. Try the game!
gui.guhs.creche.wens.slaap: to be tucked in with a snuggle blankie
gui.guhs.creche.slaapt_al: Shh! This baby guh is already asleep.
gui.guhs.creche.deze_slaapt: This baby guh just keeps on sleeping. Check the ones that are awake!
gui.guhs.creche.niet_jouw_spel: Nyeg, someone else is helping Miss Snuggles right now.
gui.guhs.creche.handen_vol: Your hands are full! (%s baby guhs at a time)
gui.guhs.creche.ontsnapt: Nyeg! Miss Snuggles had to bring one back herself.
gui.guhs.creche.klaar: Done! %s baby guhs brought back, %s points: %s Pacifier Coins.
gui.guhs.creche.record: New record: %s points (was %s)! +%s Pacifier Coins. WAHOOG!
gui.guhs.creche.weggelopen: You walked out of the Snuggle Daycare. Miss Snuggles takes over.
gui.guhs.creche.gewiegd: Rock-a-bye... %s baby guh(s) grow a little. Zzz...
gui.guhs.creche.titel.klaar.sub: Any moment now they'll crawl away!
gui.guhs.creche.titel.go.sub: Right-click a baby guh and bring it back
gui.guhs.creche.liedje.uitleg: Press space (or click) when a little star is in the moon. Gently rock along...
gui.guhs.creche.liedje.gelukt: Zzz... the baby guh is asleep! Sweet dreams.
gui.guhs.creche.liedje.mislukt: The baby guh is still awake. One more time?
gui.guhs.knus.slaapliedjes.sterretjes.in: Out there walks a cheese nibble... no wait, out there twinkles a little star. The very first song Miss Snuggles teaches you: rock slowly, to and fro.
gui.guhs.knus.slaapliedjes.maantje.info: A soft little waltz about the moon watching over the Guhmension. It makes the baby guhs all chonky and sleepy.
gui.guhs.knus.slaapliedjes.knabbeltje.in: A bouncy song about a cheese nibble under your pillow, for when you wake up tomorrow. But no eating it in bed, nyeg!
gui.guhs.knus.slaapliedjes.wolkje.info: Slowly drifting down, like a pink little cloud sinking off to sleep. The last song: after this, everyone really is asleep. Zzz.
advancements.guhs.knuffeldal.theehuis_ge: Hold a snug little tea party with your tame guhs at the Nibble Tea House
advancements.guhs.knuffeldal.theehuis_ze: Serve something from the Nibble Bakery at a snug tea party. Mmm, WAHOOG!
advancements.guhs.knuffeldal.theehuis_th: Brew or drink all four kinds of tea
block.guhs.theetafel.lore: A round table with a flowery tablecloth. Put guh chairs around it for a tea party.
item.guhs.theetafel.lore: A round table with a flowery tablecloth. Put guh chairs around it for a tea party.
block.guhs.theepotje.lore: Put something yummy in it (cheese nibbles, cheese milk, tea herb or guh flowers): two cups of tea!
item.guhs.theepotje.lore: Put something yummy in it (cheese nibbles, cheese milk, tea herb or guh flowers): two cups of tea!
item.guhs.feest_theeservies.lore: Mrs. Teaspoon's prettiest tea set, borrowed for the Great Cozyfest. Careful!
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.theeguh: Pours tea for anyone who wants to sit and chonk for a while. She always stirs with her big teaspoon and knows every kind of tea. Bring your tame guhs along for a tea party: snug!
quest.guhs.theeguh.hoi.0: Welcome to the Nibble Tea House, sweetie! A cup of tea? Or a whole tea party?
quest.guhs.theeguh.hoi.1: Oh, how snug that you're here. Did you bring your guhs? Then we'll set the table!
quest.guhs.theeguh.hoi.2: A guh is never too chonky for another cup of tea. Just maybe not wahoog enough! Hee hee.
quest.guhs.theeguh.bezig: There's a tea party going on right now, sweetie. Come back in a bit!
quest.guhs.theeguh.bezig_jij: Your tea party is on! Look above your guhs' cups to see what they want.
quest.guhs.theeguh.geen_tafel: Nyeg, where is my tea table? No table, no tea party.
quest.guhs.theeguh.geen_guhs: I don't see any tame guhs of yours! Bring them inside and we'll have a tea party.
quest.guhs.theeguh.start: Sit down and get comfy, everyone! (%s guests) Pour tea when someone wants tea, and serve something tasty when someone's peckish. Pastries from the Nibble Bakery are the very yummiest!
quest.guhs.theeguh.huisthee: Here, %s cups of nibble tea on the house. You can brew more tea in a teapot.
quest.guhs.theeguh.gezellig: What a snug table! Everyone is totally cozy. Come visit again soon, sweetie.
quest.guhs.theeguh.theemutsje: Since it was your first snug tea party: a tea cozy hat for your guh! I bet it looks adorable.
quest.guhs.theeguh.theeservies: For the Great Cozyfest? Then I'll lend you my very best party tea set. Bring it to Mayor Chonkworth, and watch out for Crumb Mikas!
quest.guhs.theeguh.bijna: It was quite cozy (%s of %s), but not really snug yet. More tea next time!
quest.guhs.theeguh.gestopt: Okay sweetie, then I'll clear away the cups. Until next time!
gui.guhs.theehuis.knop.start.tooltip: Your tame guhs (up to 6) sit down at the tea table: pour tea and serve something yummy
gui.guhs.theehuis.scherm.uitleg: Fancy a tea party? %s of your tame guhs can join. Pour tea, serve something yummy and chat away. A snug table makes everyone cozy!
gui.guhs.theehuis.scherm.feest: The Great Cozyfest! After a snug tea party I'll lend you my party tea set. %s of your tame guhs can join.
gui.guhs.theehuis.scherm.geen_guhs: I don't see any of your tame guhs nearby, dearie. Bring them along and we'll set the table!
gui.guhs.theehuis.scherm.bezig: %s is hosting a tea party right now. Come back in a bit!
gui.guhs.theehuis.scherm.bezig_jij: Your tea party is going: snugness %s of %s.
gui.guhs.theehuis.scherm.tip: Tip: you brew tea in a teapot.
gui.guhs.theehuis.wil_thee: %s would love a cup of tea!
gui.guhs.theehuis.kletst: %s is having a snug little chat.
gui.guhs.theehuis.heeft_al: %s still has plenty, thank you! Nyeg.
gui.guhs.theehuis.vergeten: %s wanted something else... oh well, chatting is nice too.
gui.guhs.theehuis.theepotje.leeg: Put something yummy in it: cheese nibbles, cheese milk, tea herb or guh flowers.
item.guhs.knabbelthee.lore: Tea made of cheese nibbles: golden brown, crunchy in taste and a little bit snug.
gui.guhs.knus.theesoorten.knabbelthee.in: Mrs. Teaspoon's house tea: brewed from cheese nibbles in a little teapot. Makes you Snug for half a minute.
item.guhs.kaasmelkthee.lore: Creamy and soft. Washes away all nasty effects!
gui.guhs.knus.theesoorten.kaasmelkthee.i: Tea with cheese milk from the Guh Farm. So creamy that every nasty effect melts right away.
item.guhs.theekruidthee.lore: Green and fresh, from tea herb out of your garden. Perks you right up.
Tea herb from your own little garden in a teapot: fresh green tea that perks you right up.
item.guhs.guhbloementhee.lore: Pink tea made of guh flowers. So snug, for a whole minute and a half!
gui.guhs.knus.theesoorten.guhbloementhee: Guh flowers make pink tea that smells like spring. The snuggest tea of all.
advancements.guhs.knuffeldal.kapper_eers: Give a guh a new hairstyle at Snip & Chonk (or put a hairstyle on your own tame guh)
advancements.guhs.knuffeldal.kapper_show: Score at least 120 points in one of Curly the Barber's salon shows
advancements.guhs.knuffeldal.kapper_alle: Fill the whole Hairstyle Collection: all 8 hairstyles and all 8 hair dyes
gui.guhs.knus.kapsels.kapsel_krullen.inf: A mop of chonky little curls, everywhere. Can't comb it, can cuddle it.
gui.guhs.knus.kapsels.kapsel_kuifje.info: A tough little quiff pointing forward: that way to the cheese nibbles!
gui.guhs.knus.kapsels.kapsel_knotjes.inf: Two buns on top, like two cheese rolls. Super cute.
gui.guhs.knus.kapsels.kapsel_strikjes.in: Two pigtails with white bows. For when your guh wants to look extra sweet.
gui.guhs.knus.kapsels.kapsel_pluisbol.in: One enormous puffball: the ears just poke right through. WAHOOG!
gui.guhs.knus.kapsels.kapsel_vlechtjes.i: Two long braids with a little bow at the end. Almost down to the pawsies!
gui.guhs.knus.kapsels.kapsel_hanenkam.in: A mohawk made of fluff: tough at the front, sweet at the back.
gui.guhs.knus.kapsels.kapsel_matje.info: Business in the front, party in the back. The famous guh mullet.
gui.guhs.knus.kapsels.haarverf_regenboog: Rainbow hair keeps changing color, just like a Rainbow Guh. Only at Curly's!
gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.kapperguh: Rarity: Unique (Snip & Chonk, in every Snuggledale town)
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.kapperguh: Curly the Barber snips, curls and blow-dries every guh wahoog pretty. He sets his own curls every morning with a cheese nibble in the curlers. A guh is never too chonky for a new hairdo, he always says: just not wahoog enough.
item.guhs.feestkapselset.lore: Clips, bows and glitter spray for the party hairdos. Bring it to Mayor Chonkworth!
item.guhs.kappersschaar.lore: Borrowed from Curly the Barber. Right-click a customer to give them a trim.
item.guhs.kappersschaar.lore2: Shift + right-click your own tame guh: all the hair comes off (nyeg!)
item.guhs.haarverf.lore: Right-click your own tame guh that has a hairstyle: their hair gets this color
item.guhs.kapsel.lore: A lasting hairstyle: right-click your own tame guh (the old hairstyle is then gone)
gui.guhs.knus.mijlpaal.kapper_eigen_guh: Took your own guh to the barber
gui.guhs.scorebord.kapper.punten: most points in one salon show
gui.guhs.kapper.alleen_eigen: Nyeg! Only your own tame guh can go to the hair salon.
gui.guhs.kapper.eerst_kapsel: Nyeg, a hairstyle first! You can't dye bald little tufts.
gui.guhs.kapper.geverfd: %s now has %s hair. Pretty as a picture!
gui.guhs.kapper.al_kaal: Nyeg, there's nothing left to snip.
gui.guhs.kapper.kaal: Snip snip snip... %s is back to au naturel. Nyeg!
gui.guhs.kapper.geen_kapsel: %s doesn't have a hairstyle yet. Buy one from Curly the Barber!
quest.guhs.kapper.hoi.0: Welcome to Snip & Chonk! A guh is never too chonky for a new hairdo... just sometimes not wahoog enough. Fancy a salon show?
quest.guhs.kapper.hoi.1: Curl curl! My customers are already waiting. Will you help me snip? The Mikas snatched my cheese nibbles, so I can use all the help I can get!
quest.guhs.kapper.hoi.2: Nyeg, so much fluff today! Grab the scissors and let's make something wahoog of it.
quest.guhs.kapper.bezig: You're still busy! Your customer is waiting, hurry up with those scissors!
quest.guhs.kapper.druk: Nyeg, the salon is taken! Watch for a bit, your turn is coming.
quest.guhs.kapper.schaar: Here, a pair of barber scissors. You can borrow them. Don't snip your own ears, guh!
quest.guhs.kapper.geen_stoel: Nyeg... where did my barber chair go? No chair, no show.
quest.guhs.kapper.niet_jouw_klant: That's not your customer! Nyeg, no cutting in line.
quest.guhs.kapper.uitleg: The salon show begins! %s customers sit in the chair one by one. Look carefully at the photo: that's the hairstyle and color they want. First wash 3x, then snip, then dye, and blow-drying finishes it off. The faster, the more points, and perfect hairdos in a row give a combo!
quest.guhs.kapper.uitleg_feest: The party salon show! %s party guests want a party hairdo for the Great Cozyfest. Get enough points and you'll get the Party Hairdo Kit for Mayor Chonkworth!
quest.guhs.kapper.weggelopen: You walked out of the salon: the show is over!
quest.guhs.kapper.klaar: The show is done! %s points, %s perfect hairdos for %s customers: %s Curl Coin(s).
quest.guhs.kapper.record_eerste: Your first record: %s points! Will you make the top 3 above the show chair? WAHOOG!
quest.guhs.kapper.eerste: Your first salon show! A little welcome gift: 4 Curl Coins. Nyeg, you snip so nicely!
quest.guhs.kapper.feest_gelukt: WAHOOG! What party hairdos! Here's the Party Hairdo Kit. Bring it to Mayor Chonkworth, quick!
quest.guhs.kapper.feest_bijna: Nyeg, almost! For the Party Hairdo Kit you need at least %s points. One more time?
quest.guhs.kapper.uitslag.njeg: Nyeg... nothing right, but the customer still says a sweet thank you. +%s point
quest.guhs.kapper.uitslag.te_laat: The customer still had to get to the Nibble Bakery... but waves a sweet goodbye.
quest.guhs.kapper.bar.foto_weg: The photo is put away! Do you remember?
gui.guhs.kapper.uitleg: Customers sit down in the chair one by one, with a photo of the hairstyle they want. Wash, snip, dye, blow-dry: the faster and neater, the more points and Curl Coins!
gui.guhs.kapper.bezet: %s is putting on a salon show right now. Only one at a time: watch along and wait your turn!
gui.guhs.kapper.start.tooltip: 8 customers, each with their own wish. During the show you don't get hungry or hurt.
gui.guhs.kapper.feest.tooltip: For the Great Cozyfest: score at least %s points and you get the Party Hairdo Kit
gui.guhs.kapper.shop.tooltip: Hairstyles and hair dye for your own guh, the barber's cape and salon furniture, for Curl Coins
gui.guhs.kapper.geen_best: No record yet: time for a show!
gui.guhs.kapper.munten: Curl Coins in your pocket: %s (1 per 20 points +1)
gui.guhs.kapper.eerste: At your first show you get a little welcome gift!
gui.guhs.kapper.knip.wassen.tooltip: Lather three times, then the hair is clean enough to snip
gui.guhs.kapper.knip.fohn.tooltip: Done? The hair dryer finishes it off and the customer leaves happy. Take one more look at the photo first!
gui.guhs.kapper.knip.stop.tooltip: The show stops; you get the Curl Coins for your points
gui.guhs.kapper.knip.sluit.tooltip: The screen closes, the show goes on! Right-click the customer to come back
gui.guhs.kapper.knip.aftellen: Ready, set... the first customer is coming in any moment!
gui.guhs.kapper.knip.volgende: Ding-a-ling... here comes the next customer!
advancements.guhs.knuffeldal.boerderij_g: Find Farmer Haybale's Guh Farm, in the Guh Meadows or the Cheese Flats
advancements.guhs.knuffeldal.boerderij_v: Make a farm animal happy: pet, brush and feed it (two of the three in one day)
advancements.guhs.knuffeldal.boerderij_a: Get fluff wool, a nibble egg and cheese milk from your happy farm animals. WAHOOG!
block.guhs.guh_voerbak.lore: Put nibble feed in it: the farm animals eat from it by themselves
item.guhs.guh_voerbak.lore: Put nibble feed in it: the farm animals eat from it by themselves
block.guhs.kippennestje.lore: Happy nibble chicks lay their nibble eggs here
item.guhs.kippennestje.lore: Happy nibble chicks lay their nibble eggs here
item.guhs.pluiswol.lore: Super soft, from a happy guh lamb
item.guhs.knabbelei.lore: An egg from a happy nibble chick, crunchy as a cheese nibble
item.guhs.kaasmelk.lore: Creamy and a little bit cheesy. From a happy guh cow. Moo!
item.guhs.guhborstel.lore: Brush the farm animals: fluffy is happy
item.guhs.knabbelvoer.lore: Yummy for lambs, chicks and cows (and secretly for guhs too)
structure.guhs.guhboerderij.tooltip: Farmer Haybale's farm: guh lambs, nibble chicks, guh cows and a veggie patch
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.boerinneguh: Farmer Haybale looks after all the farm animals, with a piece of straw in her mouth. She has a chore for you every day, and she sells brushes, feed, seeds and watering cans. Nyeg, let's get to work!
gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.guhschaapje: Rarity: Rare (Guh Farm, sometimes in the Guh Meadows)
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.guhschaapje: A little cloud of fluff wool with a guh head and round guh ears. Pet it, brush it and feed it: a happy lamb drops a tuft of fluff wool. Baa!
gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.knabbelkippetje: Rarity: Rare (Guh Farm, sometimes in the Cheese Flats)
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.knabbelkippetje: A round, cheese-yellow chick with big guh eyes. When it's happy, it lays a nibble egg in a little nest. Cluck cluck, wahoog!
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.guhkoe: A chonky cow with cheese spots (with holes!), a pink guh snout and two little horns. Make her happy and hold out an empty bottle: cheese milk! Moo!
gui.guhs.boerderij.blij.guhschaapje: The guh lamb is super happy! Baa-baa!
gui.guhs.boerderij.blij.knabbelkippetje: The nibble chick is super happy! Cluck cluck cluck!
gui.guhs.boerderij.blij.guhkoe: The guh cow is super happy! Hold an empty bottle near her for cheese milk. Moo!
gui.guhs.boerderij.koe.niet_blij: The guh cow isn't happy enough yet... Pet, brush or feed her first. Nyeg.
gui.guhs.boerderij.koe.al_gemolken: This guh cow already gave cheese milk today. More tomorrow, moo!
gui.guhs.boerderij.voerbak.vol: The feed trough is already stuffed full of nibble feed!
gui.guhs.boerderij.klus_klaar: Chore done! Go back to Farmer Haybale. WAHOOG!
gui.guhs.boerderij.beschermd: Nyeg! This is Farmer Haybale's farm: no breaking or building here.
quest.guhs.boerderij.hallo: Nyeg, hello there! I'm Farmer Haybale. Welcome to the Guh Farm! My lambs, chicks and cows only get happy when you pet, brush and feed them. And happy animals give the yummiest things: fluff wool, nibble eggs and cheese milk. WAHOOG!
quest.guhs.boerderij.al_klaar: You've already done today's chore, sweetie. I'll have something for you again tomorrow! Feel free to peek in my little shop.
quest.guhs.boerderij.bedankt0: Nyeg, well done! Here, for you: cheese nibbles, nibble feed and a little bag of seeds. WAHOOG!
quest.guhs.boerderij.bedankt1: Chore done? Then you're the most wahoog farmhand in the Guhmension! A little reward for you.
quest.guhs.boerderij.bedankt2: Just look at those happy animals! You did that. Here, some nibbles and seeds for your garden.
quest.guhs.boerderij.bedankt3: Thank you! If only those Mikas would keep their paws off my cheese nibbles, we'd all be even more wahoog... Here, take this!
quest.guhs.boerderij.klus.aaien: Nyeg, today I'd like you to pet %s animals. Just with your hand, gently on their little heads. It makes them so happy!
quest.guhs.boerderij.nog.aaien: A bit more petting: %s of %s animals petted. Nyeg!
quest.guhs.boerderij.klus.borstelen: Today's chore: brush %s animals with a guh brush. Fluffy = happy, everybody knows that!
quest.guhs.boerderij.nog.borstelen: Brush, brush! %s of %s done. Do you have a guh brush? I sell them, you know.
quest.guhs.boerderij.klus.voeren: Today: give %s animals nibble feed. From your hand, they love that the most. WAHOOG!
quest.guhs.boerderij.nog.voeren: A bit more feeding: %s of %s animals have had nibble feed.
quest.guhs.boerderij.klus.voerbak: My feed troughs are empty, nyeg! Put nibble feed in them %s times, then the animals can eat on their own.
quest.guhs.boerderij.nog.voerbak: The feed troughs: %s of %s scoops done. Right-click a feed trough with nibble feed!
quest.guhs.boerderij.klus.wol: Can you bring me %s fluff wool? Happy guh lambs shed their wool by themselves. It's for the daycare, they knit blankies!
quest.guhs.boerderij.nog.wol: I'm still waiting for fluff wool: you have %s of %s on you.
quest.guhs.boerderij.klus.eieren: Bring me %s nibble eggs, sweetie. Happy nibble chicks lay them in the chicken nests. For the baker!
quest.guhs.boerderij.nog.eieren: Nibble eggs: %s of %s. Have you checked the chicken nests?
quest.guhs.boerderij.klus.melk: Today I'd like %s bottles of cheese milk. A happy guh cow gives cheese milk when you hold an empty bottle up to her. Moo!
quest.guhs.boerderij.nog.melk: Cheese milk: %s of %s bottles. The guh cow has to be happy first, nyeg.
quest.guhs.boerderij.klus.oogst: Bring me %s things from your garden: nibble grain, tea herb or guh flowers. Home-grown is extra wahoog!
quest.guhs.boerderij.nog.oogst: Harvest from your garden: %s of %s. A watering can helps, and tame guhs help too!
advancements.guhs.knuffeldal.tuintjes_ee: Harvest your first plant from a guh flowerpot or a guh veggie planter
advancements.guhs.knuffeldal.tuintjes_tu: Fill the Garden Book: plant and harvest nibble plants, tea herb and guh flowers
block.guhs.guh_bloempot.lore: Put seeds in and give it water. Right-click when it's ripe!
item.guhs.guh_bloempot.lore: Put seeds in and give it water. Right-click when it's ripe!
block.guhs.guh_moestuinbak.lore: A whole row of little plants in a planter. Tame guhs water it!
item.guhs.guh_moestuinbak.lore: A whole row of little plants in a planter. Tame guhs water it!
item.guhs.guh_gieter.lore: Right-click a garden: water! Empty? Refill it at some water.
item.guhs.knabbelzaadjes.lore: Grows into a little nibble plant full of nibble grain
item.guhs.theekruidzaadjes.lore: Grows into a fragrant bunch of tea herb
item.guhs.guhbloemzaadjes.lore: Grows into a guh flower (with a little face!)
item.guhs.knabbelgraan.lore: Crunchy grain for the baker's nibble dough
item.guhs.theekruid.lore: Smells like mint and cheese nibbles. For the tea house!
item.guhs.guhbloemetje.lore: A pink little flower that looks back at you. Five make a party bouquet
item.guhs.feestboeket.lore: For Mayor Chonkworth's Great Cozyfest. WAHOOG!
gui.guhs.tuintjes.gieter_leeg: The watering can is empty! Right-click water to fill it up.
gui.guhs.tuintjes.gieter_vol: Glug glug glug... the watering can is full again!
gui.guhs.tuintjes.feestboeket_klaar: What a party bouquet! Bring it to Mayor Chonkworth for the Great Cozyfest. WAHOOG!
gui.guhs.knus.mijlpaal.tuintjes_guhs: Watered by a tame guh ten times
gui.guhs.knus.mijlpaal.tuintjes_zang: Five plants grown by guh singing
gui.guhs.knus.tuinboek.knabbelzaadjes.in: Plant them in a guh flower pot or guh veggie planter. Water helps, and so do singing guhs!
gui.guhs.knus.tuinboek.knabbelgraan.info: Golden ears full of crunchy little cheese nibble kernels. Baker Crusty makes dough out of them.
Small and green. A tame guh loves to water them, nyeg.
gui.guhs.knus.tuinboek.theekruid.info: A bunch of mint-green herb with little white flowers. Mrs. Teaspoon makes tea from it.
gui.guhs.knus.tuinboek.guhbloemzaadjes.i: Pink seeds with little dots. What might come out? A flower that looks back at you!
gui.guhs.knus.tuinboek.guhbloemetje.info: A pink flower with little ears and a little face. Five make a party bouquet for the Cozyfest.
advancements.guhs.knuffeldal.sterrenwach: Find the Guh Observatory, high up on the Guh Peaks or the Chonk Cliffs
Look through a guh telescope at night and connect your first guh constellation
Find a rare constellation during a Star Shower
Find all 15 guh constellations, including the three from the Star Shower. WAHOOG, stargazer!
block.guhs.guh_telescoop.lore: At night: right-click and connect the stars into a guh constellation
item.guhs.guh_telescoop.lore: At night: right-click and connect the stars into a guh constellation
block.guhs.sterrenlantaarn.lore: A little lantern with a star inside. For the Great Cozyfest!
item.guhs.sterrenlantaarn.lore: A little lantern with a star inside. For the Great Cozyfest!
item.guhs.wensster.lore: Right-click and make a wish! (Or pay Professor Twinkle with it)
structure.guhs.guh_sterrenwacht.tooltip: Professor Twinkle's observatory, high in the mountains: connect the stars into guh constellations at night
gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.sterrenkijkerguh: Rarity: Rare (Guh Observatory, Guh Peaks and Chonk Cliffs)
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.sterrenkijkerguh: Looks through his giant telescope at the guh constellations every night. The Big Nibble is his favorite. Sells star lanterns and his stargazer outfit for wishing stars.
gui.guhs.sterrenwacht.beschermd: Nyeg! The Guh Observatory belongs to Professor Twinkle. No breaking or building here!
gui.guhs.sterrenwacht.bezig: Nyeg, you're still busy with something else. Finish that first!
gui.guhs.sterrenwacht.overdag: During the day you only see the sun, nyeg. Come back when it's dark!
gui.guhs.sterrenwacht.te_laat: Nyeg, the stars have already turned: you looked too long. Take another peek through the telescope!
gui.guhs.sterrenwacht.klopt_niet: Hmm, those lines don't match Professor Twinkle's sky. Take another peek through the telescope, nyeg!
gui.guhs.sterrenwacht.moe: Your eyes are tired from all that stargazing (%s per night). More tomorrow night! Zzz...
gui.guhs.sterrenwacht.hint: Click a star and then the next one to draw a line
gui.guhs.sterrenwacht.wens.knabbels: Your wish comes true: a handful of cheese nibbles! Nom, WAHOOG!
gui.guhs.sterrenwacht.wens.gefrituurd: Your wish comes true: fried cheese nibbles! Extra crunchy, nyeg!
gui.guhs.sterrenwacht.wens.ballon: Your wish comes true: guh balloons! Party!
gui.guhs.sterrenwacht.wens.lantaarn: Your wish comes true: star lanterns, right out of the sky!
gui.guhs.sterrenwacht.wens.geluk: Your wish comes true: you feel light, happy and super wahoog!
gui.guhs.sterrenwacht.wens.vahoeg: WOW, a super wish: WAHOOG chonk ingots! That only happens once in a blue moon...
quest.guhs.sterrenwacht.hallo: Oh! Visitors! Welcome to the Guh Observatory, I'm Professor Twinkle. Every night I watch the guh constellations: The Big Nibble, The Little Chonk, the Guh Ear... Come back tonight and look through a telescope. Connect the stars and you'll get wishing stars. WAHOOG!
quest.guhs.sterrenwacht.knusfeest: Star lanterns for the Cozyfest? Nyeg, of course! Connect a constellation in a telescope tonight and I'll give you %s. Then the party will be just as pretty as the sky!
quest.guhs.sterrenwacht.regen: A STAR SHOWER! Quick, to the telescope! Now you can see the rare constellations: The Golden Guh, The Falling Nibble and The Guh Crown!
quest.guhs.sterrenwacht.nacht: It's dark, the stars are out! Look through a telescope and connect them. I'll keep your atlas up to date, nyeg.
quest.guhs.sterrenwacht.nacht_moe: You've done enough stargazing for tonight. Go get some cozy sleep, they'll be back tomorrow night.
quest.guhs.sterrenwacht.tip0: Did you know there are twelve guh constellations? And during a star shower three more, very rare ones!
quest.guhs.sterrenwacht.tip1: You can hold a wishing star in your hand and make a wish. Just right-click. What do you wish for? Usually cheese nibbles, nyeg.
quest.guhs.sterrenwacht.tip2: The Fleeing Mika: a Mika with a sack of stolen cheese nibbles. That's why the guhs are never wahoog enough! He runs and runs...
quest.guhs.sterrenwacht.tip3: My dome is a guh head, see the ears? That's how I hear the little stars twinkle.
quest.guhs.sterrenwacht.tip4: For wishing stars I have my stargazer hat and star cape in guh size. Your guh will look super starry!
quest.guhs.sterrenwacht.tip5: Your very own Guh Telescope? I'll trade you one for eight wishing stars. Then you can stargaze at home!
quest.guhs.sterrenwacht.tip6: During the day I sleep a little. Stargazers are wahoog at night and chonky by day. Nyeg.
quest.guhs.sterrenwacht.gevonden_nieuw: WAHOOG! You found %s! I'll write it in your Star Atlas. Here, %s wishing stars!
quest.guhs.sterrenwacht.gevonden_weer: Ah, %s! You already knew that one, but it's still lovely. Here, %s wishing stars.
quest.guhs.sterrenwacht.lantaarns: And for the Cozyfest: %s star lanterns! Bring them to the mayor.
gui.guhs.knus.sterrenatlas.grote_knabbel: A giant cheese nibble with a little hole. The most famous guh stars in the whole sky: whoever finds it always gets a little more wahoog. Nyeg!
gui.guhs.knus.sterrenatlas.kleine_vads.i: A little guh head with two little ears. Baby guhs always look for it first, because it looks like them.
gui.guhs.knus.sterrenatlas.guhoor.info: One big, round guh ear. Grandpa Guh says it's listening for Mikas sneaking up.
gui.guhs.knus.sterrenatlas.vluchtende_mi: A Mika running off with a sack of stolen cheese nibbles. That's why the guhs aren't wahoog enough! He's been running for a thousand years and never gets anywhere.
gui.guhs.knus.sterrenatlas.kaasschaaf.in: A handle and a little blade: the stars of cheese slicing. Handy for extra-thin nibbles.
A guh fast asleep, with a Z above it. Zzz... chonk.
gui.guhs.knus.sterrenatlas.frituurpannet: A round little pan with a long handle. That's where the stars get fried, they say.
A big, round, WAHOOG belly. That's how a guh should look after a good party!
gui.guhs.knus.sterrenatlas.guhstaart.inf: A curly little tail made of stars. It wags a bit if you look long enough.
gui.guhs.knus.sterrenatlas.knuffelhart.i: A heart for everyone you cuddle. It shines brightest over Snuggledale.
gui.guhs.knus.sterrenatlas.luchtballon.i: A hot-air balloon with a basket: Captain Cloudy's favorite constellation.
gui.guhs.knus.sterrenatlas.kampvuur.info: A little flame on two little logs: Grandpa Guh's favorite constellation.
gui.guhs.knus.sterrenatlas.gouden_guh.in: RARE (only during a star shower): a whole guh face of golden stars. Whoever sees it gets three wishes, says Professor Twinkle. Or one really big one.
gui.guhs.knus.sterrenatlas.vallende_knab: RARE (only during a star shower): a cheese nibble with a long tail, on its way to a hungry guh.
gui.guhs.knus.sterrenatlas.guhkroon.info: RARE (only during a star shower): the crown of the King Guh, with five points.
advancements.guhs.knuffeldal.ballon_gevo: Find the Balloon Festival in the Guh Fields or the Pink Puffs
advancements.guhs.knuffeldal.ballon_eers: Go on a balloon flight with Captain Cloudy
advancements.guhs.knuffeldal.ballon_alle: Collect all eight balloon stamps: fly all four routes
block.guhs.ballonsteiger.lore: The hot-air balloon waits here. Talk to Captain Cloudy to climb aboard!
item.guhs.ballonsteiger.lore: The hot-air balloon waits here. Talk to Captain Cloudy to climb aboard!
block.guhs.mini_luchtballon.lore: A tiny guh balloon with a teeny-tiny burner. Doesn't really float, but almost
item.guhs.mini_luchtballon.lore: A tiny guh balloon with a teeny-tiny burner. Doesn't really float, but almost
item.guhs.ballonmunt.lore: For every balloon flight. Spend it at Captain Cloudy
structure.guhs.ballonfestival.tooltip: Captain Cloudy takes you up in his guh hot-air balloon, past the prettiest views
gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.ballonguh: Rarity: Rare (Balloon Festival, Guh Fields and Pink Puffs)
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.ballonguh: Flies his guh hot-air balloon over the Guhmension and tells you about everything you see. High, higher, WAHOOG! After every flight, a stamp on your Balloon Stamp Card.
gui.guhs.ballon.beschermd: Nyeg! The Balloon Festival belongs to Captain Cloudy. No breaking or building here!
gui.guhs.ballon.praat_met_wolkje: Talk to Captain Cloudy to fly along!
gui.guhs.ballon.blijf_zitten: Nyeg! No jumping, we're up high! Stay snug in the basket.
quest.guhs.ballon.hallo: Ahoy, ground guh! Captain Cloudy here. I fly my Guh Hot-Air Balloon past the prettiest spots in the Guhmension. You don't have to steer, just look. After every flight you get a stamp. Today we're flying %s. Hopping in, nyeg?
quest.guhs.ballon.instappen: All aboard! Today we're flying %s. Keep your pawsies inside the basket, nyeg!
quest.guhs.ballon.al_in_de_lucht: My balloon is already in the air! Just wait a bit, it'll be back soon.
quest.guhs.ballon.geen_ballon: Oopsie, where did my balloon go? Without a balloon dock I can't get a new one either. Nyeg...
quest.guhs.ballon.winkel: My little shop! For Balloon Coins: a balloon cap, balloon goggles and mini hot-air balloons.
gui.guhs.ballon.wolkje.menu: Ahoy, ground guh! Today we're flying %1$s. Your Balloon Stamp Card has %2$s of the %3$s views and you've flown along %4$s time(s). What will it be, nyeg?
gui.guhs.ballon.wolkje.uitleg: I fly four loops, each past two views. No steering needed: stay snug in the basket and look. After landing you get a stamp for every new view, and Balloon Coins for my little shop. I always pick the loop where you still miss a stamp. Your Balloon Stamp Card is in the Guhdex, on the Cozy tab. WAHOOG!
quest.guhs.ballon.landen: There's the balloon dock again. Gently landing... almost... FLOMP!
quest.guhs.ballon.geland: Landed! You'd already stamped these views, but they're still lovely, right? %2$s Balloon Coins for you.
quest.guhs.ballon.geland_stempels: Landed! %1$s new stamp(s) on your card (%3$s/%4$s) and %2$s Balloon Coins. WAHOOG flying!
quest.guhs.ballon.afgebroken: Oh dear, the flight was cut short. We're safely back down. Better luck next time, nyeg!
quest.guhs.ballon.vertrek.pluisjesronde: Burner on! We're flying the Fluff Loop: first over the flower field, then right through a cloud!
quest.guhs.ballon.onderweg.pluisjesronde: Feel how softly we're rising? Soft as a bit of fluff. That's why it's called the Fluff Loop.
Did you know the Mikas wanted a balloon too? But it was too heavy from all those stolen cheese nibbles. FLOMP!
quest.guhs.ballon.vertrek.hoge_vads: Burner on! Today it's the High Chonk: as high as a balloon can go. Don't look down... or do!
quest.guhs.ballon.onderweg.hoge_vads.0: Higher and higher... my ears are already flapping. Yours too?
quest.guhs.ballon.onderweg.hoge_vads.1: A real balloonist is never scared, just a little chonky. Nyeg.
quest.guhs.ballon.vertrek.knabbelkring: Burner on! The Nibble Circle goes past the Giant Guh and a very special little cloud.
Look, down there the festival guhs are waving! Wave back!
This route is called the Nibble Circle because I always eat a cheese nibble along the way. *nibble*
quest.guhs.ballon.vertrek.zonnetjesroute: Burner on! The Sunshine Route: with a little hop and the prettiest view of them all.
quest.guhs.ballon.onderweg.zonnetjesrout: Smell that? Fresh air with a whiff of cheese sauce. Lovely.
Sometimes from up here I see Professor Twinkle waving, at his observatory in the mountains.
quest.guhs.ballon.uitzicht.guhgezichtvel: Look down! There's a giant guh face made of flowers in the grass. From up here it's smiling at you, nyeg!
Here comes the flower field, just look down...
gui.guhs.knus.ballonstempels.guhgezichtv: A guh face made of flowers, so big you can only see it from the sky. The festival guhs plant it again every year.
quest.guhs.ballon.uitzicht.wolkenpoort: We're flying THROUGH a cloud! Everything's all white and soft, just like a guh cuddle. Pfff, WAHOOG!
quest.guhs.ballon.uitzicht.wolkenpoort.k: Hold on tight, there's a big fat cloud right in front of us...
gui.guhs.knus.ballonstempels.wolkenpoort: A cloud to fly right through. Inside it smells of cheese nibbles, says Captain Cloudy. (That's not true.)
quest.guhs.ballon.uitzicht.hoogste_puntj: Can't go any higher! This is the very top of the High Chonk. WAHOOG! See how tiny everything is down there?
Burner wide open... we're going even higher, and higher...
gui.guhs.knus.ballonstempels.hoogste_pun: The very highest point of all the balloon flights. From up here you can see the whole Guhmension, and a little bit of tomorrow.
quest.guhs.ballon.uitzicht.regenboogboch: Look to the side! A rainbow, just for us! That only happens when you fly wahoog enough.
Look to the side, here comes Rainbow Bend...
gui.guhs.knus.ballonstempels.regenboogbo: A rainbow that pops up in the bend. Captain Cloudy says he painted it himself. Nyeg.
quest.guhs.ballon.uitzicht.reuzenguh: There's the Giant Guh! A balloon so big it never gets fully blown up. Give a wave, he can see you!
quest.guhs.ballon.uitzicht.reuzenguh.kom: Look down to the left, someone very big is lazing about down there...
gui.guhs.knus.ballonstempels.reuzenguh.i: The biggest guh balloon of the whole festival. It always lies half-inflated in the grass, because it's a bit of a chonk.
quest.guhs.ballon.uitzicht.hartjeswolkje: A little cloud shaped like a heart! That means someone's getting extra cuddles today. Maybe you!
I see something pink ahead of us... just wait...
gui.guhs.knus.ballonstempels.hartjeswolk: A little heart-shaped cloud: whoever sees it gets extra cuddles that day. It's science.
quest.guhs.ballon.uitzicht.brandersprong: BURNER WIDE OPEN! Hup, up we go! Tickles your tummy, right? WAHOOG!
Ready for a little hop? Hold on to your hat...
gui.guhs.knus.ballonstempels.branderspro: One big WHOOMPH from the burner and the balloon jumps up. Every baby guh's favorite bit.
quest.guhs.ballon.uitzicht.guhmensie_uit: And now... hush for a moment. Look around you: the pink fields, the mountains, the sea far away. Isn't the Guhmension beautiful?
Just a little longer and you'll see the prettiest view of them all...
gui.guhs.knus.ballonstempels.guhmensie_u: The prettiest view over the Guhmension. Captain Cloudy always goes a little quiet up there.
advancements.guhs.knuffeldal.kamperen_ge: Find a campsite in Snuggledale or the Guh Meadows
advancements.guhs.knuffeldal.kamperen_ee: Listen to one of Grandpa Guh's stories by the campfire
advancements.guhs.knuffeldal.kamperen_al: Listen to all twelve of Grandpa Guh's stories (one per night!)
advancements.guhs.knuffeldal.kamperen_sl: Sleep a whole night in a guh sleeping bag
block.guhs.guh_slaapzak.lore: Sleep without a bed! (Your spawn point stays where it was.) After a whole night: well-rested
item.guhs.guh_slaapzak.lore: Sleep without a bed! (Your spawn point stays where it was.) After a whole night: well-rested
structure.guhs.kampeerplekje.tooltip: A campfire with little guh tents: at night Grandpa Guh tells a story there
gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.opa_guh: Rarity: Rare (campsites, and on his bench in Snuggledale)
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.opa_guh: Loves sitting by the campfire and tells a story from the old days every night: about Mikas, cheese nibbles and why guhs have such big ears. Twelve stories, one per night. Nyeg, nighty-night!
gui.guhs.kamperen.beschermd: Nyeg! This campsite belongs to Grandpa Guh. No breaking or building here!
gui.guhs.kamperen.slaapzak_bezet: Someone is already in this sleeping bag. Zzz...
gui.guhs.kamperen.geen_thuis: A sleeping bag isn't a home: your spawn point stays where it was.
gui.guhs.kamperen.uitgerust: You slept so well in your sleeping bag! You feel totally well-rested. WAHOOG!
quest.guhs.kamperen.hallo: Hey, hello there, little one. I'm Grandpa Guh. In the daytime I take a nap, but in the evening I tell stories by the campfire. A different one every night. Will you come listen tonight? Bring a sleeping bag, nyeg.
quest.guhs.kamperen.tip0: Zzz... huh? Oh, it's still daytime. Come back tonight when the campfire is burning. Then I'll tell a story.
quest.guhs.kamperen.tip1: You sleep just as well in a sleeping bag as in a bed. And you wake up very well-rested, honest.
quest.guhs.kamperen.tip2: At night the guhs by the campfire put on their pajamas. So cute. I've got some myself too, shh.
quest.guhs.kamperen.tip3: I know twelve stories. My grandpa knew thirteen, but he forgot the last one. Nyeg.
quest.guhs.kamperen.tip4: Try sneaking up to me (sneak + talk): then I'll show you my sleeping bags and pajamas.
quest.guhs.kamperen.winkel: Have a look, little one. Sleeping bags, nightcaps and pajamas. For a few cheese nibbles, nyeg.
quest.guhs.kamperen.begin: Come closer, by the fire. Tonight's story is called: %s.
quest.guhs.kamperen.aanschuiven: Pull up a seat, little one. We've already started. Shh...
quest.guhs.kamperen.te_laat: Oh, you're late, little one! The story's almost over. You can listen in, but the cheese nibbles are for those who hear the whole story. Come back later for a new one, nyeg.
quest.guhs.kamperen.einde_half: And that was the story. You only heard the tail end, didn't you? Ask me for a whole story later, nyeg.
gui.guhs.kamperen.marshmallow: You toast a marshmallow nibble over the campfire... golden brown and gooey. Mmm, WAHOOG!
gui.guhs.kamperen.marshmallow_overdag: You toast marshmallows at the campfire in the evening, nyeg. Just a little longer!
quest.guhs.kamperen.marshmallow0: Mmm, do I smell a marshmallow nibble? Not too close to the fire, little one, or it'll turn black. Nyeg.
quest.guhs.kamperen.marshmallow1: In the old days we toasted cheese nibbles on a stick. Until the Mikas came to snatch them... Eat up quick!
quest.guhs.kamperen.marshmallow2: Sticky snoot? That's part of a campfire. It makes you nice and WAHOOG, nyeg.
quest.guhs.kamperen.marshmallow_sst: (Grandpa Guh sniffs, winks, and then quietly carries on...)
quest.guhs.kamperen.sst: Shh... just listen. The story isn't over yet.
quest.guhs.kamperen.morgen: One story per night, little one. Tomorrow I'll tell you a new one. Now off to sleep... zzz.
quest.guhs.kamperen.geen_vuur: Where did the campfire go? No campfire, no story, nyeg. Will you light one?
quest.guhs.kamperen.einde_nieuw: And that was the story. It's in your Story Collection now. Here, %s cheese nibbles to put under your pillow.
quest.guhs.kamperen.einde: And that was the story. You knew that one already, didn't you? Still lovely. Here, %s cheese nibbles.
gui.guhs.knus.mijlpaal.kamperen_uitgesla: A whole night in a sleeping bag
gui.guhs.knus.mijlpaal.kamperen_marshmal: Toasted 5 marshmallow nibbles at the campfire
gui.guhs.knus.mijlpaal.kamperen_pyjamafe: Pajama party: 5 guhs in pajamas at a story
gui.guhs.knus.verhalenbundel.eerste_kaas: How a star that fell into the cheese sauce became the first cheese nibble, and the littlest guh was the first to shout WAHOOG.
quest.guhs.kamperen.verhaal.eerste_kaask: Long, long ago, when my grandpa was still a baby guh, there were no cheese nibbles at all.
The guhs ate grass. Just grass. They were sweet, but they were never, ever wahoog. Nyeg.
One night a star fell out of the sky. It rolled down the hill and came to rest in a little puddle of cheese sauce.
The next morning that star had turned crunchy and yellow, and it smelled... mmm... like cheese.
The littlest guh took a bite. And then another. And then he shouted: WAHOOG!
And so the very first cheese nibble was born. Ever since, all guhs search the sky for falling stars.
And that's why, little ones, a cheese nibble is really a little piece of starry sky. Night night... *yawn*
gui.guhs.knus.verhalenbundel.mika_die_ni: About the very first Mika, who hid all his nibbles, and the guhs who brought him a cake instead of getting angry.
quest.guhs.kamperen.verhaal.mika_die_nie: Do you know the Mikas? They're not really mean, you know. They just never learned to share.
The very first Mika found a sack of cheese nibbles. He had enough for a hundred guhs.
But instead of sharing, he hid them. In a cave. Under a rock. In his socks.
The guhs in the village went quiet and a bit floppy. They weren't wahoog enough, and that made them sad.
So the guhs went to the Mika, not angry, but with a cake. A homemade cake.
The Mika couldn't believe his eyes. Someone just giving something to HIM? He ran off giggling... without his nibbles.
Mikas still steal to this day, nyeg. But deep down inside, they just want a piece of cake too.
gui.guhs.knus.verhalenbundel.groot_vadsf: The party with the cake as tall as a tree, the crumb trail, and the Crumb Mika who got to join the feast after all.
quest.guhs.kamperen.verhaal.groot_vadsfe: My grandpa's grandpa once threw the biggest party the Guhmension has ever seen.
There was a cake as tall as a tree, and cheese nibbles in every color of the rainbow.
But just as the party started... a Crumb Mika snatched the whole top layer of the cake! Crumbs everywhere!
Grandpa's grandpa didn't get angry. He followed the crumb trail, nice and calm, through the whole village.
At the end, the Crumb Mika was sitting under a bush, with cake on his nose. He was giggling nervously.
Grandpa's grandpa gave him a cheese nibble and said: 'Come along, there's enough for everyone.'
And so that year there was one more guest at the party. A bit crumbly, but very snug. Nyeg!
gui.guhs.knus.verhalenbundel.pluk_niet_v: About Pip, whose nibbles kept getting stolen, and the friends who kept searching until he was all wahoog again.
quest.guhs.kamperen.verhaal.pluk_niet_va: Once upon a time there was a little guh called Pip. Pip was small and a bit skinny, and he didn't like that.
No matter how hard he searched, every time he found a cheese nibble, a Mika snatched it away. Not wahoog again!
The other guhs never said he was too skinny, or too chonky, or too anything. Guhs don't say things like that.
Instead, they all went searching. Together. A long line of guhs, ears up, noses down.
And every nibble they found, they shared with Pip. Nom nom nom.
By the end of the week Pip was round and cheerful and totally, totally WAHOOG.
Remember, little ones: a guh is never too chonky. Sometimes he just needs a little help to become wahoog.
gui.guhs.knus.verhalenbundel.grote_oren: Why Guhs Have Such Big Ears
Why the guhs got such big round ears: from all that listening for Mikas sneaking up.
quest.guhs.kamperen.verhaal.grote_oren.0: Have you ever wondered why guhs have such big, round ears? Well, listen closely.
quest.guhs.kamperen.verhaal.grote_oren.1: Long ago, guhs had teeny tiny ears. So tiny they never heard a Mika sneaking up.
quest.guhs.kamperen.verhaal.grote_oren.2: So cheese nibbles kept disappearing. Nobody heard a thing. Tip-tip-tip... gone!
quest.guhs.kamperen.verhaal.grote_oren.3: Then the guhs decided that every evening, before bed, they would listen very carefully. To the wind. To the stars.
quest.guhs.kamperen.verhaal.grote_oren.4: And from all that listening, their ears grew bigger. And bigger. And rounder.
quest.guhs.kamperen.verhaal.grote_oren.5: Now guhs can hear a Mika from a hundred steps away. Even when he's tiptoeing. Even when he's whispering.
quest.guhs.kamperen.verhaal.grote_oren.6: So if your ears tickle a little at night... they're growing just a tiny bit more. Shh, listen.
gui.guhs.knus.verhalenbundel.knabbelberg: The Nibble Mountain at the End of the World
About the Guh End, the floating islands and the Nibble Mountain, where the Mikas keep all the stolen cheese nibbles.
Far, far away, past the last guh villages, lies the Guh End. There, islands float in the sky.
And in the middle stands Nibble Mountain: a mountain of every cheese nibble the Mikas ever stole.
Some guhs say it reaches all the way to the stars. Others say it smells like fried cheese.
Only the bravest guhs go there. Not to fight, mind you. Guhs don't fight.
They go there to bring the nibbles back, so everyone at home can become wahoog again.
Maybe one day you'll go there too. Then bring enough cheese nibbles for the journey.
But not yet, okay? First, a good night's sleep. Nibble Mountain isn't going anywhere. Nyeg.
gui.guhs.knus.verhalenbundel.grote_knabb: How the Big Nibble Got into the Sky
The guh who showed their prettiest cheese nibble to the moon, so now it hangs among the stars forever.
quest.guhs.kamperen.verhaal.grote_knabbe: Look up. See those stars there, shaped like a cheese nibble? That's The Big Nibble.
A long, long time ago there was a guh who loved cheese nibbles so much, he wanted to show them to everyone.
So he climbed the highest mountain, with the most beautiful nibble he had.
He held it up as high as he could and shouted: LOOK! WAHOOG!
The moon thought it was so pretty that she gently picked it up and placed it among the stars.
Now every guh can see it, every night. Professor Twinkle says it still smells a little bit like cheese.
If you ever find it through a telescope, make a wish. It always listens.
gui.guhs.knus.verhalenbundel.wolkjes_eer: How Cloudy flew above the clouds for the first time in a balloon made of old guh socks, and became Captain Cloudy.
quest.guhs.kamperen.verhaal.wolkjes_eers: Captain Cloudy wasn't always a captain. He was just Cloudy, a little guh who loved watching clouds.
He wanted to fly so badly. He tried with an umbrella. FLOMP. With a bedsheet. FLOMP. With his ears. Double FLOMP.
Then he saw a soap bubble float away, and he thought: warm air goes up!
He sewed a balloon out of old guh socks, in the shape of his own head. Ears and all.
The first time he went up one block. The second time two. The third time... all the way above the clouds!
From up there he saw the whole Guhmension, and he cried a little, because it was so beautiful.
Ever since, he takes along everyone who wants to see it too. Maybe you tomorrow, nyeg!
gui.guhs.knus.verhalenbundel.kaasregen: The Day It Rained Cheese Nibbles
gui.guhs.knus.verhalenbundel.kaasregen.i: The first cheese shower, when all the guhs ran outside with their mouths wide open and even the Mikas forgot to steal.
quest.guhs.kamperen.verhaal.kaasregen.0: It doesn't happen often, but sometimes... sometimes it rains cheese nibbles. Honest!
quest.guhs.kamperen.verhaal.kaasregen.1: The first time it happened, nobody knew what was going on. Tick, tick, tick, on all the roofs.
quest.guhs.kamperen.verhaal.kaasregen.2: The guhs ran outside with their mouths open. Nom! Nom! Nom!
quest.guhs.kamperen.verhaal.kaasregen.3: Even the Mikas came to look. They completely forgot to steal, they were so happy.
quest.guhs.kamperen.verhaal.kaasregen.4: That day everyone was wahoog at the same time. Guhs, Mikas, even the little bees.
quest.guhs.kamperen.verhaal.kaasregen.5: It was the snuggest day the Guhmension has ever known.
quest.guhs.kamperen.verhaal.kaasregen.6: So if you ever see a cheese shower: run outside, open your mouth, and share with whoever's next to you.
gui.guhs.knus.verhalenbundel.verdwaalde_: About the baby guh who got lost in the woods and found their mama again by singing.
quest.guhs.kamperen.verhaal.verdwaalde_b: Once upon a time there was a baby guh who followed a butterfly. Very far. Much too far.
When he looked back, his family was gone. Only trees. Tall, dark giant guh trees.
He sat down on a rock and his little ears drooped. He didn't feel wahoog at all.
But do you know what he did then? He sang. A very soft guh song. Guh, guh, guh.
And far away, very far away, his mama heard that song, with her big round ears.
She found him, cuddled him, and together they snuggled into a warm guh nest that night.
So if you ever get lost, little one: just sing. There's always a guh listening.
gui.guhs.knus.verhalenbundel.mika_met_go: The Mika with the Heart of Gold
About the best nibble thief of all the Mikas, who one night gave everything back, plus a few extra.
quest.guhs.kamperen.verhaal.mika_met_gou: Not all Mikas keep stealing forever. This is the story of Mika Goldheart.
He was the best nibble thief of them all. He even stole nibbles from other Mikas' pockets.
One evening he saw a little guh crying, because all his nibbles were gone. Because of him.
Mika Goldheart got a funny feeling in his tummy. Not hunger. Something else.
That night he sneaked back and put all the nibbles in front of the door again. Plus a few extra.
The next morning the little guh was so wahoog that he hopped around all day. And Mika secretly watched and smiled.
Maybe every Mika has a little golden heart. You just have to let it shine a bit. Night night.
Grandpa Guh's most favorite story of all: how a cold, bare valley turned into soft pink Snuggledale, straight out of a guh's dream.
