gui.guhs.verhalen.laden: Fetching the stories... nyeg, hang on!
gui.guhs.verhalen.klik: Click a story to see exactly what to do next
gui.guhs.verhalen.ding.rps: Wins in a row against the Mika Boss
gui.guhs.verhalen.beloning.sledesprint: Sled Sprint races against Steele Mika
gui.guhs.verhalen.beloning.wolkjes: Bring guhs back from the clouds (%s times so far)
gui.guhs.verhalen.beloning.maag: Your own guhbelly (and the Dentist Guh)
gui.guhs.verhalen.mewtwo.alle_notities: nowhere anymore: you have all six
gui.guhs.verhalen.knusfeest.alles_bij_je: nowhere anymore: you have everything with you
gui.guhs.verhalen.timmerguh.uitleg: Carpenter Guh has built half a guh house. Help him with the roof and get his building booklet!
gui.guhs.verhalen.timmerguh.nu.0: Talk to Carpenter Guh and tell him you want to help.
gui.guhs.verhalen.timmerguh.nu.1: Bring Carpenter Guh 16 planks (any wood) and 8 pink wool. He'll turn them into roof fluffs.
gui.guhs.verhalen.timmerguh.nu.2: Climb the scaffolding and fill every ghostly spot of the ear roof with roof fluffs. Pluff!
gui.guhs.verhalen.timmerguh.nu.3: Place your small Guh House at your home, right-click it and choose New Resident. Then tell Carpenter Guh.
gui.guhs.verhalen.timmerguh.nu.3_bewoner: A guh already lives in your house, wahoog! Hurry and tell Carpenter Guh.
gui.guhs.verhalen.timmerguh.nu.4: Extra chore: put a toy and a guh lamp by one of your Guh Houses (in your home area) and tell Carpenter Guh.
gui.guhs.verhalen.timmerguh.nu.4_knus: Your house is all cozied up! Tell Carpenter Guh to get your tool belt.
gui.guhs.verhalen.timmerguh.nu.klaar: The house is finished and super cozy. With the building booklet you can now build all three Guh Houses yourself!
gui.guhs.verhalen.timmerguh.waar.0: Talk to Carpenter Guh at the build site on the edge of Snuggledale (Snuggledale biome)
gui.guhs.verhalen.timmerguh.waar.1: Bring it to Carpenter Guh at the build site in Snuggledale
gui.guhs.verhalen.timmerguh.waar.2: The roof of the build site in Snuggledale (up the scaffolding!)
gui.guhs.verhalen.timmerguh.waar.3: Your own home, and then Carpenter Guh in Snuggledale
gui.guhs.verhalen.timmerguh.waar.3_bewon: Talk to Carpenter Guh at the build site in Snuggledale
gui.guhs.verhalen.timmerguh.waar.4: At your Guh House at home, and then Carpenter Guh in Snuggledale
gui.guhs.verhalen.timmerguh.waar.4_knus: Talk to Carpenter Guh at the build site in Snuggledale
gui.guhs.verhalen.timmerguh.waar.klaar: Build it yourself at the workbench, with the building booklet
gui.guhs.verhalen.balto.uitleg: The baby guhs of Nomguh are sick. Only Baltoguh dares to brave the snowstorm to the mountain hut...
gui.guhs.verhalen.balto.stap.1: Visit Rosy at the little hospital
gui.guhs.verhalen.balto.nu.0: Talk to Baltoguh, the little wolf guh by the old boat. Don't listen to Steele Mika!
gui.guhs.verhalen.balto.nu.1: Go to Rosy at the little hospital: the baby guhs are sick. Achoo-nyeg!
gui.guhs.verhalen.balto.nu.2: Ask Boris the goose for advice. Honk!
gui.guhs.verhalen.balto.nu.3: Talk to Baltoguh and choose "Off to the mountain hut!": then the sled trip begins.
gui.guhs.verhalen.balto.nu.4: Steer the sled along the route through the snowstorm to the mountain hut and grab the medicine chest.
gui.guhs.verhalen.balto.nu.5: Hurry back to Nomguh before time runs out! At the darkest moment, howl along with Baltoguh.
gui.guhs.verhalen.balto.nu.6: Bring the medicine chest to Rosy: the baby guhs will get better!
gui.guhs.verhalen.balto.nu.klaar: You're the Hero of Nomguh! Now race the Sled Sprint against Steele Mika too.
gui.guhs.verhalen.balto.nu.klaar_tem: You're the Hero of Nomguh! Baltoguh wants to come with you: talk to him by the old boat.
gui.guhs.verhalen.balto.waar.0: Baltoguh by the old boat in Nomguh's frozen bay (Snowguh Tundra)
gui.guhs.verhalen.balto.waar.1: Talk to Rosy at Nomguh's little hospital (the white house with the pink heart)
gui.guhs.verhalen.balto.waar.2: Talk to Boris on the old boat in Nomguh's frozen bay (Snowguh Tundra)

gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.kraakguh: Rarity: Rare: at night in the Palewood, near a tree with a Creaking Guh Heart
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.kraakguh: A guh made of pale wood, with moss on its head. It belongs to a Creaking Guh Heart and only comes out at night. It only moves when nobody is looking: look at it and it stands stock-still. Look away... creak! All it wants is to give you a wooden hug (that makes you slow for a moment). Hitting it doesn't help: cheese resin just drips from its tree. At sunrise it crumbles away, and also when you chop its heart out of the tree.
gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.kraak_mika: Rarity: Very Rare: at night in the Palewood, near a tree with a Soured Guh Heart
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.kraak_mika: A Mika made of pale wood with yellow-green eyes. It comes out of a soured heart. Just like the Creakguh it only moves when nobody is looking, but it doesn't come to hug: it comes to shove. NYEG! It doesn't hurt. After a few good whacks it has had enough and crawls back into its tree until the next night.
book.guhs.bleekwoud.dagboek.0:
Diary of the Woodcutter Guh.

Day 1. Wahoog! I found a forest full of pale trees. Lovely white wood, and so nice and quiet. Not a guh in sight. I'll build a little hut and get chopping. Nyeg!
book.guhs.bleekwoud.dagboek.1: Day 2. Something creaked outside last night. Creak... creak... Must be the wind. But there is never any wind here. I pulled my blankie over my little ears.
book.guhs.bleekwoud.dagboek.2: Day 3. There is a wooden guh standing between the trees. It wasn't there yesterday! It doesn't move. It only stares. With little orange eyes.
book.guhs.bleekwoud.dagboek.3: Day 4. I looked at my axe for a moment. When I looked up again, the wooden guh stood CLOSER. I looked away. Creak. Even closer! As long as I look, it stands still.
book.guhs.bleekwoud.dagboek.4: Day 5. I stared at it all night long. My eyes are stinging. When the sun came up, it just crumbled away. And something is beating inside that thick tree, just like a little heart. Ba-dum.
book.guhs.bleekwoud.dagboek.5: Day 6. I had to sneeze. Achoo! Eyes shut. And then... a hug. A wooden hug! Creak! For a moment I could hardly walk. It only wanted a cuddle. Quite sweet, really.
book.guhs.bleekwoud.dagboek.6: Day 7. Sweet or not: I want a good night's sleep. I'm moving to Snuggledale, nothing creaks there. Whoever reads this: keep looking, or let it hug you. But watch out for the sour hearts: a Mika comes out of those. NYEG! Bye, hut.

gui.guhs.skyblok.grap.uitleg: One island, one tree and a manual of 4,812 steps. For real pros only, says the Skyblok Guh.

quest.guhs.skyblok.hallo: Quiet. I'm in a call. ...Okay. %s, this is Skyblok. One island. One tree. Four thousand eight hundred and twelve steps. For real pros only, Nyeg. Do you dare?
quest.guhs.skyblok.hallo.opnieuw: You again, %s. You completed Skyblok. Nobody completes Skyblok! I've been training on step 1 for three years. ...Want another go?
quest.guhs.skyblok.uitleg: You stand on THE island, high up in the sky. Very high. Real sky, honest, nothing fake about it. Follow the manual at the top of your screen. And whatever you do: do NOT lie down in that bed. That's for beginners, Nyeg.
quest.guhs.skyblok.kwijt.hier: Tsk. A pro doesn't lose their stuff. Here, a new Island in a Bottle. Take good care of it, Nyeg.

gui.guhs.bedwars.grap.uitleg: Four teams want to get to your bed. You defend it, with everything you've got. Says the Bedwars Guh, in his armor made of pillows.

quest.guhs.bedwars.hallo: HALT! Who goes there? Oh, %s. I'm the Bedwars Guh. See this armor? Real pillows. Down! In Bedwars there is only one rule: defend your bed. With everything you've got, Nyeg!
quest.guhs.bedwars.hallo.opnieuw: There's %s, the best bed defender in all of Guhpixel! Zero beds destroyed. ZERO. Want to defend your bed once more?
quest.guhs.bedwars.uitleg: You get a little island with a bed. Four teams live around you: Red, Blue, Green and Yellow. They're coming, over little bridges of wool. You defend your bed. How? You'll find out. Tip: it's a really comfy bed, Nyeg.

gui.guhs.bedwars.titel.verdedig.onder: They're coming over the wool, Nyeg!
gui.guhs.bedwars.ligt: You're lying in your bed. Now nobody can get to it. Perfect defense, Nyeg!

gui.guhs.bedwars.dutje: %1$s lies down next to your bed. Zzz... (naps: %2$s)

gui.guhs.vadsnite.duwtje: The driver lends a paw: off you go, through the hatch!
gui.guhs.vadsnite.geland: Landed! Now just be the last one awake. That can never take long, Nyeg...
gui.guhs.vadsnite.wolk: Yaaawn... the sleep cloud. Pink and soft. Nothing happens, but it sure is cozy, Nyeg.
gui.guhs.vadsnite.gelijkspel.onder: Everyone is asleep. It's a draw, Nyeg.
gui.guhs.vadsnite.einde.gelijkspel: You lay down too. Now really everyone is asleep. That simply counts, Nyeg!
gui.guhs.vadsnite.einde.overwinning: All %s guhs are asleep. You're the only one still awake. You didn't have to do a thing. Wahoog!
gui.guhs.vadsnite.nee.breken: Chopping wood? In Chonknite we only nap, Nyeg.

quest.guhs.bzg.intro.1: Dear viewers, welcome to a brand-new season of Farmer Wants a Guh!
quest.guhs.bzg.intro.2: This year: Farmer Guhrrit. He has a farm, a straw hat and a whole lot of hay. The only thing missing is somebody to snore next to.
quest.guhs.bzg.intro.3: We got piles of letters! Well, three. The candidates are on the sofa already. Give them a wave.
quest.guhs.bzg.intro.4: Would you take the letters out of the mailbox and read them? I lost my reading glasses, nyeg.
quest.guhs.bzg.kandidaat.hoi.1: Hi! I came all the way from the city. I took a nap on the train to warm up.
quest.guhs.bzg.kandidaat.hoi.2: Hello... Is that real hay over there? I've been dreaming about it for weeks.
quest.guhs.bzg.kandidaat.hoi.3: Good day. I snore in three keys. It's in my letter, too.
quest.guhs.bzg.keuze.vraag: Snoozie, Dozeline or Snorebert... All three of them slept so beautifully. Who should I choose, nyeg?
quest.guhs.bzg.samen.twijfel: %s? Yes... But what about the other two? They look so sweet lying there. I can't, nyeg. I can't choose!
quest.guhs.bzg.samen.allemaal: All of them? Is that allowed? I bet that's not in the script... But I couldn't choose anyway, nyeg!
quest.guhs.bzg.samen.2: You know what? The hay is big enough. All three of you just stay. As friends. Nap friends.
quest.guhs.bzg.samen.3: WAHOOG! Can I have the spot by the window, then?
quest.guhs.bzg.samen.4: Dear viewers, we have never seen this before: everybody wins and everybody sleeps. See you next season!

book.guhs.bzg.brief.1.tekst: I'm Snoozie and I live in the city. It's busy and noisy there, so I only sleep in until nine in the morning. My hobbies are afternoon naps, morning naps and going for walks (to my basket). I heard the countryside is so quiet you can hear yourself yawn. That sounds lovely. I can also sleep standing up, by the way, which is handy for milking.
book.guhs.bzg.brief.2.tekst: My name is Dozeline. Ever since I was a tiny guh I have dreamed of lying in real hay. At home I only have a pillow, and it's just not the same. I'm very caring: when you sleep, I'll happily sleep along. I love long conversations, as long as they don't take too long. I can't cook, but I can look at cheese nibbles very sweetly until somebody gives them to me.
book.guhs.bzg.brief.2.groet: Lots of love and good night, Dozeline
book.guhs.bzg.brief.3.tekst: I, Snorebert, hereby apply for the position of your guh. I have eleven years of experience in sleeping and I snore in three keys. References are available on request, but they're asleep right now. My strengths: lying down, sitting, and lying down. My weakness: getting up. I am available immediately, unless I happen to be asleep. I look forward to hearing from you, preferably after nap time.
book.guhs.bzg.bedankbrief.tekst: Thank you for your help with the show. Snoozie, Dozeline and Snorebert all live on the farm now. We get up early every day, around eleven, and then we lie down again right away. The cows more or less milk themselves. The hay has never been this flat. Do drop by sometime, but knock softly: somebody is always asleep. You tucked us in so nicely back then, nyeg.
book.guhs.bzg.bedankbrief.groet: A big hug from Farmer Guhrrit (and the rest, who are asleep)

book.guhs.guhkantoor.kwartaal.intro.0: It was another quiet quarter. Very quiet.
book.guhs.guhkantoor.kwartaal.intro.1: Management looks back happily on three months of top-level lying down.
book.guhs.guhkantoor.kwartaal.intro.2: This quarter was all about rest, routine and even more rest.
book.guhs.guhkantoor.kwartaal.intro.3: Despite the rush (there was no rush) everything got done (there was nothing to do).
book.guhs.guhkantoor.kwartaal.intro.4: The figures are stable. Remarkably stable. Suspiciously stable.
book.guhs.guhkantoor.kwartaal.intro.5: This quarter too, the Guh Office stayed true to its core values: sleeping and nyeg.
book.guhs.guhkantoor.kwartaal.intro.6: A thorough investigation shows: nothing happened. As planned.
book.guhs.guhkantoor.kwartaal.intro.7: The shareholders (two pillows and a little blanket) are satisfied.
book.guhs.guhkantoor.kwartaal.intro.8: We proudly present: exactly the same result, once again.
book.guhs.guhkantoor.kwartaal.intro.9: A quarter never to forget, though nobody remembers what happened.
book.guhs.guhkantoor.kwartaal.taart.5: Mood on the work floor: 100% content
book.guhs.guhkantoor.kwartaal.punt.1: The annual plan is finished: it says "nyeg".
book.guhs.guhkantoor.kwartaal.punt.2: New house rule: whisper after clocking in.
book.guhs.guhkantoor.kwartaal.punt.3: The printer printed one sheet. It was blank. Everyone is proud.
book.guhs.guhkantoor.kwartaal.punt.4: The office plant was watered. Not much else happened.
book.guhs.guhkantoor.kwartaal.punt.5: The suggestion box held one idea: "more pillows". Passed unanimously.
book.guhs.guhkantoor.kwartaal.punt.6: The coffee machine has been named a colleague.
book.guhs.guhkantoor.kwartaal.punt.7: Everyone slept through the fire drill. Passed.
book.guhs.guhkantoor.kwartaal.punt.8: A committee was set up to find out what a committee is.
book.guhs.guhkantoor.kwartaal.punt.9: Staff outing held: everyone slept one desk further along.
book.guhs.guhkantoor.kwartaal.punt.10: The password was changed to "jjjjjjjj". Nobody knows why.
book.guhs.guhkantoor.kwartaal.punt.11: A customer called. We snored back. The customer will call again.
book.guhs.guhkantoor.kwartaal.punt.12: The phone rang. After a while it stopped by itself.
book.guhs.guhkantoor.kwartaal.punt.13: The goal "stay awake until lunch" has been moved to next year.
book.guhs.guhkantoor.kwartaal.punt.14: The new chairs spin. That was the news.
book.guhs.guhkantoor.kwartaal.punt.16: One nibble went missing. The trail leads to a little belly.
book.guhs.guhkantoor.kwartaal.punt.17: The archive was tidied up: it was under a guh.
book.guhs.guhkantoor.kwartaal.punt.18: The New Year's party was in March. Nobody was awake before that.
book.guhs.guhkantoor.kwartaal.punt.19: The minutes of the meeting: "zzz". Approved.
book.guhs.guhkantoor.kwartaal.punt.20: The internet was slow. Nobody noticed.
book.guhs.guhkantoor.kwartaal.punt.21: The deadline was met, by another department.
book.guhs.guhkantoor.kwartaal.punt.22: A desk was added. There is now sleeping in more places.
book.guhs.guhkantoor.kwartaal.punt.23: The office was named the quietest workplace in the Guhmension.
book.guhs.guhkantoor.kwartaal.punt.24: The course "Efficient Yawning" was a great success.
book.guhs.guhkantoor.kwartaal.punt.25: Job requirements tightened: must be able to lie down.
book.guhs.guhkantoor.kwartaal.punt.26: The paperclips were counted. There are still just as many.
book.guhs.guhkantoor.kwartaal.punt.27: The Time Clock ticked. That was the highlight of Tuesday.
book.guhs.guhkantoor.kwartaal.punt.28: The keyboards are warmer than ever.
book.guhs.guhkantoor.kwartaal.punt.29: The staff asked for a siesta. They already had one.
book.guhs.guhkantoor.kwartaal.punt.30: Strategy for next year: the same, but lying down.
book.guhs.guhkantoor.kwartaal.punt.31: A Mika came by to shove. Nobody woke up. He just left again.
book.guhs.guhkantoor.kwartaal.punt.32: The elevator was not used. There is no elevator either.
book.guhs.guhkantoor.kwartaal.punt.33: The meeting about the meeting is postponed until after the meeting.
book.guhs.guhkantoor.kwartaal.punt.34: Friday afternoon drinks began on Monday morning.
book.guhs.guhkantoor.kwartaal.punt.35: A vote was held about the window: open. After that everyone slept fresher.
Conclusion: everything stays as it is. Chonk.
Conclusion: the line is flat, and that takes skill.
Conclusion: no profit, no loss, but well rested.
Conclusion: we do nothing, but we do it very well.
Conclusion: the figures don't lie. They sleep.
Conclusion: stability is a result too.
Conclusion: things are going great, we suspect.
Conclusion: zero is a number too, and a nicely round one.
Conclusion: the plan worked, because there was no plan.
Conclusion: everyone is happy and nobody knows what about.
Conclusion: it won't get better than this. Or worse.

gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.gids.uitleg: Buy a Guh Cinema Set in the Guhpixel shop, put the projector in front of a screen of Cinema Screen and pick a movie. Your guhs come and sit by themselves!
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.film.skyblok.uitleg: One little island, 4,812 steps and a bed. Guess which one wins.
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.film.skyblok.slot: Finish Skyblok in the Guhpixel lobby.
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.film.skyblok.o1: Welcome to Skyblok. An epic adventure starts here, nyeg.
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.film.skyblok.o2: Step 1 of 4,812: build a cobblestone generator.
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.film.skyblok.o3: In the chest: ice. And a bucket of lava you are not allowed to use.
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.film.skyblok.o4: Oops. Oh well. It wasn't allowed anyway, nyeg.
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.film.skyblok.o5: What a lovely sky. So blue. So... close?
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.film.skyblok.o6: The sky is a painted box. Do not jump into it, nyeg.
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.film.skyblok.o8: ...or a nap. Let's see what the bed does.
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.film.skyblok.o9: SKYBLOK COMPLETED! The only thing that works here is the bed.
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.film.skyblok.o10: The goal in life is chonking. Not a cobblestone generator.
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.film.bedwars.uitleg: Four teams, one bed. Defend it... by lying in it.
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.film.bedwars.slot: Finish Bedwars in the Guhpixel lobby.
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.film.bedwars.o1: Four teams, four little islands. And one very important bed.
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.film.bedwars.o2: Defend your bed with everything you've got, nyeg!
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.film.bedwars.o3: The best defense: lie in it yourself.
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.film.bedwars.o5: The enemy is building a bridge. Very. Slowly.
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.film.bedwars.o6: Block by block they come closer...
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.film.bedwars.o7: They're here! They're next to your bed! They...
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.film.bedwars.o8: ...cozily lie down beside you. Good night.
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.film.bedwars.o10: Five? Yes. The camera guh slept too, nyeg.
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.film.vadsnite.uitle: 100 guhs jump out of the Chonk Bus. Who is the last one awake?
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.film.vadsnite.slot: Finish Chonknite in the Guhpixel lobby.
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.film.vadsnite.o1: 100 guhs jump out of the Chonk Bus. Who stays awake?
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.film.vadsnite.o2: Pick your landing spot wisely, nyeg!
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.film.vadsnite.o3: Where do we land? Doesn't matter: soft grass everywhere.
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.film.vadsnite.o4: Landed! And... everybody falls asleep at once.
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.film.vadsnite.o6: The sleep cloud is closing in. It is pink. And very soft.
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.film.vadsnite.o7: Don't fall asleep. Don't fall asleep. Don't...
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.film.vadsnite.o8: #1 CHONK ROYALE! You are the only one still awake!
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.film.vadsnite.o9: ...and now everybody really is asleep. A tie, nyeg.
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.film.guhmon.uitleg: A real Guhmon battle! Whoever falls asleep first wins.
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.film.guhmon.slot: Win the Guhmon Battle in the Guhpixel lobby.
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.film.guhmon.o1: Gym Leader Naps challenges you to a Guhmon battle!
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.film.guhmon.o2: Whoever sleeps first wins. Really, nyeg.
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.film.guhmon.o7: Guh used Eat Nibble! Munch, munch.
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.film.guhmon.o8: Full belly: a little sleepier every turn.
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.film.guhmon.o9: Naps' guh used Nap! That goes fast!
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.film.guhmon.o10: Guh used Chonk... and falls asleep first!
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.film.guhmon.o11: Guh is asleep! You win the battle!
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.film.guhmon.o12: You slept faster. Here is your gym badge, nyeg.
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.film.bzg.uitleg: Farmer Guhrrit is looking for a guh to chonk with. Three letters have arrived!
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.film.bzg.slot: Finish Farmer Wants a Guh in the Guhpixel lobby.
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.film.bzg.o1: Welcome to Farmer Wants a Guh! I am Host Guhvon.
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.film.bzg.o2: Farmer Guhrrit is looking for a guh to chonk with.
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.film.bzg.o3: Farmer Guhrrit, three letters have arrived for you!
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.film.bzg.o4: Three! That is almost four, nyeg.
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.film.bzg.o5: Letter one: 'Dear farmer, I really love sleeping.'
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.film.bzg.o6: Letter two: 'I love sleeping too. And nibbles.'
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.film.bzg.o7: Letter three fell asleep while writing.
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.film.bzg.o8: The sleepover week! Day one through seven: everybody sleeps.
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.film.bzg.o9: Shhh... let's tuck them in nice and snug.
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.film.bzg.o10: Farmer Guhrrit, it is time. Who do you choose?
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.film.bzg.o11: ...I can't choose, nyeg. All three snore so beautifully.
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.film.bzg.o13: And they chonked happily ever after.
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.film.among.uitleg: Aboard The Chonkfarer somebody is the Mika. But who is actually awake?
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.film.among.slot: Finish the Among Guhs parody round with Captain Guh in the Guhpixel lobby.
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.film.among.o1: Aboard The Chonkfarer the crew is working very hard.
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.film.among.o2: Well. Hard. All the tasks are still at zero.
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.film.among.o3: But they do look lovely lying there, nyeg.
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.film.among.o4: Emergency meeting! Somebody leaned on the button.
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.film.among.o7: The vote: who ate the last nibble?
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.film.among.o8: Everybody has crumbs. All very suspicious.
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.film.among.o9: And the Mika? Asleep in the vent.
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.film.among.o10: Sabotage: zero. Shoved: nobody. Snored: plenty.
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.film.among.o11: Crew wins! Because nobody did anything at all.
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.film.among.o12: Captain Guh: 'Want to try it for real, nyeg?'
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.film.balto.uitleg: The baby guhs of Nomguh are sick. Only Baltoguh dares to cross the snowstorm.
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.film.balto.slot: Become the Hero of Nomguh: finish the story of Baltoguh.
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.film.balto.o1: In Nomguh the baby guhs are sick. Achoo-nyeg!
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.film.balto.o2: The medicine is in the mountain hut. Behind the snowstorm.
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.film.balto.o3: Steele Mika laughs: 'That wolf guh will never make it!'
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.film.balto.o4: Baltoguh says nothing. Baltoguh grabs the sled.
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.film.balto.o5: Through the storm! Left! Right! Straight on, nyeg!
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.film.balto.o6: It is cold. It is far. But nibbles are waiting at home.
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.film.balto.o7: The mountain hut! And there: the medicine chest!
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.film.balto.o8: Back through the night. Baltoguh howls at the northern lights.
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.film.balto.o9: The northern lights don't howl back. But they are pretty.
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.film.balto.o10: The baby guhs are better! Baltoguh is the Hero of Nomguh!
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.film.balto.o11: And the hero? Already asleep. It was a long ride.
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.film.mewtwo.uitleg: The clone tank is broken and the professor has lost his notes. Who's swimming in that tank?
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.film.mewtwo.slot: Become a Friend of Guhtwo: finish the story of Clone Island.
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.film.mewtwo.o1: Professor Nibbleclone has lost his lab notes.
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.film.mewtwo.o2: And the clone tank is broken. Bad day, nyeg.
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.film.mewtwo.o3: Six notes and four tank parts later...
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.film.mewtwo.o6: It's... GUHTWO! The strongest guh ever cloned. He looks angry.
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.film.mewtwo.o7: 'I was made to fight,' says Guhtwo.
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.film.mewtwo.o8: His belly says otherwise. His belly says: nibbles.
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.film.mewtwo.o9: A double helping! And look: Mewguh is here too.
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.film.mewtwo.o10: Eating together. Digesting together. That's real power.
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.film.mewtwo.o11: Guhtwo and Mewguh: best friends. The island is saved!
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.film.stitch626.uitl: A star fell on Guhwai'i. There was a very naughty little blue guh in it.
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.film.stitch626.slot: Become an Ohana Guh: finish the story of 626-guh on Guhwai'i.
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.film.stitch626.o1: A star fell on the hill of Guhwai'i.
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.film.stitch626.o2: Inside the star was something blue. Something very naughty.
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.film.stitch626.o3: Experiment 626-guh! Made to make a mess.
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.film.stitch626.o4: And he is good at it, nyeg.
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.film.stitch626.o5: Cushions! Coconuts! Nani-guh's laundry! It all goes flying.
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.film.stitch626.o6: Lilo-guh thinks he is sweet anyway. Lilo-guh is right.
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.film.stitch626.o7: A coconut. A hibiscus. Eight cheese nibbles.
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.film.stitch626.o8: Not even a naughty experiment can resist that.
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.film.stitch626.o10: And family never leaves you behind, nyeg!
gui.guhs.guhbioscoop.film.stitch626.o11: And taking a nap together is part of that too.
structure.guhs.reisbureau.tooltip: Send your guh on vacation! He comes back with a postcard and a souvenir.
block.guhs.reisbureau_balie.lore: Send one of your guhs on vacation here. He comes back with a postcard and a souvenir, and he can never get lost. Nyeg!
item.guhs.reisbureau_balie.lore: Send one of your guhs on vacation here. He comes back with a postcard and a souvenir, and he can never get lost. Nyeg!
item.guhs.reisbureau_stempel.lore: From the Travel Agent Guh. Use it to make a Travel Desk at home. Lost it? The Travel Agent has another one.
gui.guhs.reisbureau.tip.waarschijnlijk: Your guh almost certainly brings this, together with a postcard.
gui.guhs.reisbureau.tip.met_geluk: With a bit of luck your guh brings this rare souvenir, instead of the common one.
gui.guhs.reisbureau.tip.heb_je: You already have this one: a duplicate becomes a stamp on your travel pass.
gui.guhs.reisbureau.tip.nieuw: You do not have this one yet!
gui.guhs.reisbureau.tip.echte_tijd: Trips take real time. The trip simply goes on while you are not playing.
gui.guhs.reisbureau.tip.proef: Your first little trip. Your guh only brings a postcard.
gui.guhs.reisbureau.tip.eerder: Your guh comes back right away, but without a postcard and without a souvenir. He does not mind.
gui.guhs.reisbureau.weg.klaar: %s is back and waiting at the desk!
gui.guhs.reisbureau.weg.een_tegelijk: One guh at a time may travel.
gui.guhs.reisbureau.reispas.uitleg: A duplicate souvenir becomes a stamp. Ten stamps: a Golden Suitcase!
gui.guhs.reisbureau.slot.0: First talk to the Travel Agent Guh in the Travel Agency "The Chonk Vacation" in the Guhmension. The Super Compass shows the way.
gui.guhs.reisbureau.slot.1: The Travel Agent Guh first wants the little suitcase packed: bring him the three things.
gui.guhs.reisbureau.slot.2: First the trial trip around the corner, nyeg. After that all trips open up.
gui.guhs.reisbureau.uit.ver: Not nearby. Put your guh next to the desk.
gui.guhs.reisbureau.melding.geboekt: %1$s is going on a trip: %2$s. Have a nice trip, nyeg!
gui.guhs.reisbureau.melding.bezig: A guh is already traveling. One at a time, nyeg.
gui.guhs.reisbureau.melding.niet_vandaag: That trip is not on offer today anymore. Have another look.
gui.guhs.reisbureau.melding.geen_guh: That guh is not near the desk.
gui.guhs.reisbureau.melding.guh_bezet: That guh cannot leave right now: %s
gui.guhs.reisbureau.melding.eerst_agent: First talk to the Travel Agent Guh.
gui.guhs.reisbureau.melding.nog_niet: Your guh is still on the way. Just a little patience!
gui.guhs.reisbureau.melding.al_thuis: Your guh is home already, nyeg.
gui.guhs.reisbureau.melding.geen_plek: There is no free spot here. Make some room at the desk.
gui.guhs.reisbureau.melding.terug: %1$s is back from %2$s! He is wearing sunglasses and has a postcard for you.
gui.guhs.reisbureau.melding.eerder: %s is home again. Without a souvenir, but happy to see you.
gui.guhs.reisbureau.melding.geannuleerd: The trip was canceled: your guh was gone before he could leave. He is simply at home.
gui.guhs.reisbureau.melding.stempel: You already had that one: a stamp on your travel pass! (%1$s/%2$s)
gui.guhs.reisbureau.melding.koffertje: Your travel pass is full: you get a Golden Suitcase! Wahoog!
gui.guhs.reisbureau.melding.vast: This desk belongs to the Travel Agency. Make your own at home with a Travel Stamp.
gui.guhs.reisbureau.melding.staat_klaar: %s is back from vacation and waiting at a Travel Desk!
gui.guhs.reisbureau.plek.klaar: %1$s (ready to collect at a Travel Desk)
gui.guhs.reisbureau.dagboek.vakantie: I went on vacation: %s. I wore sunglasses.
gui.guhs.reisbureau.gids.uitleg: Send one guh at a time on vacation at a Travel Desk. Trips take real time; your guh is safe and always comes back, with a postcard and a souvenir.
gui.guhs.reisbureau.gids.zoek: Find the Travel Agency "The Chonk Vacation" in the Guhmension (Super Compass) and talk to the Travel Agent Guh.
gui.guhs.reisbureau.gids.stap.1: Packing the little suitcase: bring the three things
gui.guhs.reisbureau.gids.stap.2: Send a guh on the trial trip
gui.guhs.reisbureau.gids.stap.3: Done: you have the Travel Stamp
quest.guhs.reisbureau.hallo: Welcome to Travel Agency "The Chonk Vacation", nyeg! I am the Travel Agent Guh. I send guhs on vacation. They come back with a postcard, a souvenir and sunglasses on. Would your guh like to get away too?
quest.guhs.reisbureau.optie.stempel: I lost my Travel Stamp, nyeg
quest.guhs.reisbureau.uitleg: Very simple! You pick a trip, your guh grabs his little suitcase and off he goes. A trip takes 1, 2, 8 or 24 real hours. Time goes on even when you are not playing. Your guh is safe with me: he can never get lost. Every day there are four new trips.
quest.guhs.reisbureau.koffer: Great! But first the little suitcase must be packed. A guh does not travel without: %1$s cheese nibbles for the road, %2$s piece of wool as a little pillow and %3$s piece of paper for the postcard. Will you bring them?
quest.guhs.reisbureau.koffer_nog: The little suitcase is not full yet, nyeg. I need: %1$s cheese nibbles, %2$s piece of wool (any color will do) and %3$s piece of paper.
quest.guhs.reisbureau.koffer_klaar: Nibbles, pillow, paper... the little suitcase is packed! Now a trial trip: put one of your guhs here at the desk and send him "around the corner". That only takes five little minutes.
quest.guhs.reisbureau.proef_nog: The trial trip is ready at the desk next to me. Put one of your guhs near it and pick "Trial Trip Around the Corner". Five little minutes, nyeg!
quest.guhs.reisbureau.proef_weg: Your guh is around the corner now. Exciting, isn't it? Collect him at the desk in a moment.
quest.guhs.reisbureau.klaar: He is back! Well? I bet he saw a pebble. Here is your Travel Stamp: use it to make your own Travel Desk at home. Then you do not have to come all the way here every time. Have a nice trip, nyeg!
quest.guhs.reisbureau.praatje.0: On offer today: four trips! Tomorrow four other ones. Have a look at the desk.
quest.guhs.reisbureau.praatje.1: Did you know a guh in Balconia just lies on your own couch? He still comes back rested.
quest.guhs.reisbureau.praatje.2: A duplicate souvenir is no problem: it becomes a stamp on your travel pass. Ten stamps and you get a Golden Suitcase from me.
quest.guhs.reisbureau.praatje.3: The most popular trip? Chonking at House Lingsesdijk 86. There is nothing to do there. Guhs love it.
quest.guhs.reisbureau.stempel_nieuw: Lost it? No problem, I have a whole drawer full. Here you go, a new Travel Stamp!
quest.guhs.reisbureau.stempel_heb_je: You still have your Travel Stamp, nyeg. Check your pockets.
gui.guhs.reisbureau.bestemming.lingsesdi: An hour of chonking in the garden of a little house on the dike. Nothing happens. That is the whole idea, nyeg.
book.guhs.reisbureau.kaart.lingsesdijk: Dear boss! I am lying in the garden of House Lingsesdijk 86. A duck came by. That was all. The grass here is very good for chonking. I already took three naps and it is only half past one. Nyeg!
block.guhs.reisbureau_souvenir_lingsesdi: A little house on the dike, with a guh asleep in the garden. Hang it on the wall.
item.guhs.reisbureau_souvenir_lingsesdij: A little house on the dike, with a guh asleep in the garden. Hang it on the wall.
block.guhs.reisbureau_zeldzaam_lingsesdi: The same painting, but fancy. The guh in the garden sleeps just as soundly.
item.guhs.reisbureau_zeldzaam_lingsesdij: The same painting, but fancy. The guh in the garden sleeps just as soundly.
gui.guhs.reisbureau.bestemming.kaasmarkt: Looking at cheese, sniffing cheese, carrying cheese and above all: tasting cheese. Your guh comes back round.
book.guhs.reisbureau.kaart.kaasmarkt: Hi boss! At the Cheese Market you may taste everything. So I did. Everything. After that the cheese carriers had to carry me too. I am bringing a little stack of cheese wheels, if I do not eat them on the way. Nyeg!
item.guhs.reisbureau_kaart_kaasmarkt: Postcard: Day at the Cheese Market
block.guhs.reisbureau_souvenir_kaasmarkt: Three cheese wheels on top of each other. Do not eat them, it is a souvenir. Really. Nyeg.
Three cheese wheels on top of each other. Do not eat them, it is a souvenir. Really. Nyeg.
block.guhs.reisbureau_zeldzaam_kaasmarkt: The grand prize of the Cheese Market. Shines like gold, smells like cheese.
The grand prize of the Cheese Market. Shines like gold, smells like cheese.
A forest where even the trees yawn. Soft moss, no alarm clock.
book.guhs.reisbureau.kaart.vadswoud: Hello boss! There is moss everywhere in Chonkwood Forest. I sat down for a moment and then it was evening. The glowguhs turned the light on for me. I was allowed to take this moss cushion home. Wahoog!
item.guhs.reisbureau_kaart_vadswoud: Postcard: Afternoon Nap in Chonkwood Forest
A cushion of real Chonkwood moss. Smells like forest and like naps.
item.guhs.reisbureau_souvenir_vadswoud.l: A cushion of real Chonkwood moss. Smells like forest and like naps.
A little lantern full of glowguhs. They give light and sometimes take a nap too.
item.guhs.reisbureau_zeldzaam_vadswoud.l: A little lantern full of glowguhs. They give light and sometimes take a nap too.
gui.guhs.reisbureau.bestemming.knuffelda: Petting little sheep in Snuggledale. The sheep pet you back.
book.guhs.reisbureau.kaart.knuffeldal: Hi boss! I petted a little sheep. Then the sheep petted me. Then we fell asleep together in the hay. The farmer said that happens here every day. Nyeg, what a nice place!
block.guhs.reisbureau_souvenir_knuffelda: A woolly little sheep from Snuggledale. Does not say baa, but it is very soft.
item.guhs.reisbureau_souvenir_knuffeldal: A woolly little sheep from Snuggledale. Does not say baa, but it is very soft.
block.guhs.reisbureau_zeldzaam_knuffelda: The golden bell of the sweetest sheep of Snuggledale. Ting-a-ling, nyeg.
item.guhs.reisbureau_zeldzaam_knuffeldal: The golden bell of the sweetest sheep of Snuggledale. Ting-a-ling, nyeg.
gui.guhs.reisbureau.bestemming.guhwaii.u: Sun, sand and a towel. Surfing is allowed, so is lying down.
book.guhs.reisbureau.kaart.guhwaii: Aloha boss! I wanted to go surfing, but the towel was so comfy. I did build a sandcastle. It has one room: a bedroom. The sea came to look and liked it too. Nyeg!
block.guhs.reisbureau_souvenir_guhwaii.l: A little castle of Guhwai'i sand, with a flag on top. One room: a bedroom.
item.guhs.reisbureau_souvenir_guhwaii.lo: A little castle of Guhwai'i sand, with a flag on top. One room: a bedroom.
block.guhs.reisbureau_zeldzaam_guhwaii.l: For the best surfer of the afternoon. Your guh mostly sunbathed on it.
item.guhs.reisbureau_zeldzaam_guhwaii.lo: For the best surfer of the afternoon. Your guh mostly sunbathed on it.
gui.guhs.reisbureau.bestemming.barbecuet: Steaming nice and warm in the sauna of the Barbecuether. Your guh comes back shiny.
book.guhs.reisbureau.kaart.barbecuether: Hello boss! It is nice and warm everywhere here. I sat in the sauna until I was all soft. Then a bath with bubbles. I smell a little like peanut sauce now, but that is part of it. Wahoog!
block.guhs.reisbureau_souvenir_barbecuet: A little wooden bucket with a ladle. Pour water on the stones: tsss. Lovely.
item.guhs.reisbureau_souvenir_barbecueth: A little wooden bucket with a ladle. Pour water on the stones: tsss. Lovely.
block.guhs.reisbureau_zeldzaam_barbecuet: A little bathtub that always stays warm. Real steam comes off it.
item.guhs.reisbureau_zeldzaam_barbecueth: A little bathtub that always stays warm. Real steam comes off it.
gui.guhs.reisbureau.bestemming.efteguh.u: Fairy tales, roller coasters and a trash can that talks. Your guh mostly rides the little boat that goes slowly.
book.guhs.reisbureau.kaart.efteguh: Hi boss! In the Efteguh stands Hungry Bulgy Guh. He shouts: paper here, nyeg! I gave him all my bits of paper. I skipped the roller coaster, the little boat went nice and slow. I fell asleep by the gnomes.
block.guhs.reisbureau_souvenir_efteguh.l: "Paper here, nyeg!" He is always hungry, but only for paper.
item.guhs.reisbureau_souvenir_efteguh.lo: "Paper here, nyeg!" He is always hungry, but only for paper.
block.guhs.reisbureau_zeldzaam_efteguh.l: A red mushroom with white dots. If you listen closely you hear a little tune.
item.guhs.reisbureau_zeldzaam_efteguh.lo: A red mushroom with white dots. If you listen closely you hear a little tune.
gui.guhs.reisbureau.bestemming.guhkenhof: Flowers as far as you can see. No lying in the flowers. (Your guh lies in the flowers.)
book.guhs.reisbureau.kaart.guhkenhof: Hello boss! So many flowers! The sign said: no lying in the tulips. So I lay next to them. My nose is yellow from sniffing. I am bringing a little vase for the table. Nyeg!
block.guhs.reisbureau_souvenir_guhkenhof: A little vase with pink tulips from the Guhkenhof. They stay pretty forever.
A little vase with pink tulips from the Guhkenhof. They stay pretty forever.
block.guhs.reisbureau_zeldzaam_guhkenhof: Tulips in every color at once. Nobody knows how they do it.
Tulips in every color at once. Nobody knows how they do it.
gui.guhs.reisbureau.bestemming.nomguh.ui: Sledding, snow and hot chocolate. Your guh usually just rolls down the mountain.
book.guhs.reisbureau.kaart.nomguh: Brrr, hi boss! Nomguh is white and cold and beautiful. Skiing did not work, so I rolled down the mountain. That was much faster, actually. Then hot chocolate by the stove and a four-hour nap. Nyeg!
block.guhs.reisbureau_souvenir_nomguh.lo: A snow globe from Nomguh with a tiny house inside.
item.guhs.reisbureau_souvenir_nomguh.lor: A snow globe from Nomguh with a tiny house inside.
block.guhs.reisbureau_zeldzaam_nomguh: Snow Globe Where It Really Snows
item.guhs.reisbureau_zeldzaam_nomguh: Snow Globe Where It Really Snows
block.guhs.reisbureau_zeldzaam_nomguh.lo: It always snows in this snow globe. No shaking needed, which is nice.
item.guhs.reisbureau_zeldzaam_nomguh.lor: It always snows in this snow globe. No shaking needed, which is nice.
gui.guhs.reisbureau.bestemming.guhrijs.u: The city of love, baguettes and the Eiffel Nibble Tower.
book.guhs.reisbureau.kaart.guhrijs: Bonjour boss! Guhris is very fancy. I ate a baguette that was longer than me. The Eiffel Nibble Tower is made of nibbles all over, but you may not eat from it. I asked. Twice. Nyeg!
block.guhs.reisbureau_souvenir_guhrijs.l: A small Eiffel Nibble Tower. You may not eat from this one either.
item.guhs.reisbureau_souvenir_guhrijs.lo: A small Eiffel Nibble Tower. You may not eat from this one either.
block.guhs.reisbureau_zeldzaam_guhrijs.l: This little tower lights up, just like the real one at night. Très chonk.
item.guhs.reisbureau_zeldzaam_guhrijs.lo: This little tower lights up, just like the real one at night. Très chonk.
gui.guhs.reisbureau.bestemming.camping.p: a little tent at Camp Chonky Tent
gui.guhs.reisbureau.bestemming.camping.u: Camping the way it should be: put up the tent, lie down in it, done.
book.guhs.reisbureau.kaart.camping: Hi boss! Putting up the tent took an hour. After that I was tired, so I lay down in it. Marshmallows over the fire in the evening. One of them was in my fur. I found it later. Yummy! Nyeg!
block.guhs.reisbureau_souvenir_camping.l: A tiny tent. Exactly one nap fits inside.
item.guhs.reisbureau_souvenir_camping.lo: A tiny tent. Exactly one nap fits inside.
block.guhs.reisbureau_zeldzaam_camping.l: A little fire that never goes out, with a marshmallow that never burns.
item.guhs.reisbureau_zeldzaam_camping.lo: A little fire that never goes out, with a marshmallow that never burns.
A city with water instead of streets. Your guh gets rowed around all day.
book.guhs.reisbureau.kaart.guhnetie: Ciao boss! In Guhnice you never have to walk anywhere. You lie down in a little gondola and somebody pushes. The gondolier sang a song. I sang along: nyeeeeg! He loved it, I think.
A little gondola from Guhnice. Just lie down, somebody else pushes.
item.guhs.reisbureau_souvenir_guhnetie.l: A little gondola from Guhnice. Just lie down, somebody else pushes.
A fancy mask with feathers and gold. Hang it on the wall.
item.guhs.reisbureau_zeldzaam_guhnetie.l: A fancy mask with feathers and gold. Hang it on the wall.
a rocket to the Cheese Moon
By rocket to the moon. It really is made of cheese. Your guh is going to check that very carefully.
book.guhs.reisbureau.kaart.kaasmaan: Hello boss, this is the moon! It really is made of cheese, I checked. I checked a lot. There is one more crater now. Floating is nice: you lie down and yet you don't. See you tomorrow, nyeg!
item.guhs.reisbureau_kaart_kaasmaan: Postcard: Trip to the Cheese Moon
A real piece of Cheese Moon, with holes. Scientific proof.
item.guhs.reisbureau_souvenir_kaasmaan.l: A real piece of Cheese Moon, with holes. Scientific proof.
A small rocket, ready for takeoff. Three, two, one... nap.
item.guhs.reisbureau_zeldzaam_kaasmaan.l: A small rocket, ready for takeoff. Three, two, one... nap.
gui.guhs.reisbureau.bestemming.wereldrei: All the way around the world in one day. That only works if you sleep a lot on the way.
book.guhs.reisbureau.kaart.wereldreis: Hi boss! I went all the way around the world. I did not see much of it, because the train, the boat, the balloon and the camel were so nice to sleep on. Exactly eighty naps. I counted them. Nyeg!
item.guhs.reisbureau_kaart_wereldreis: Postcard: Around the World in 80 Naps
block.guhs.reisbureau_souvenir_wereldrei: The whole world on a stand. Your guh took a nap everywhere.
item.guhs.reisbureau_souvenir_wereldreis: The whole world on a stand. Your guh took a nap everywhere.
block.guhs.reisbureau_zeldzaam_wereldrei: A golden globe that spins all by itself. That is how you travel without getting up.
item.guhs.reisbureau_zeldzaam_wereldreis: A golden globe that spins all by itself. That is how you travel without getting up.
gui.guhs.reisbureau.bestemming.cruise.pl: a cabin on the Guh Sea
gui.guhs.reisbureau.bestemming.cruise.ui: A day and a night on a big ship with a buffet that never closes.
book.guhs.reisbureau.kaart.cruise: Ahoy boss! The ship has a buffet that never closes. I put a deck chair next to the buffet. The captain said I am the best passenger, because I never fall overboard. I only lie down. Nyeg!
item.guhs.reisbureau_kaart_cruise: Postcard: Cruise on the Guh Sea
block.guhs.reisbureau_souvenir_cruise.lo: How did that little ship get in there? Your guh does not know either.
item.guhs.reisbureau_souvenir_cruise.lor: How did that little ship get in there? Your guh does not know either.
block.guhs.reisbureau_zeldzaam_cruise.lo: The life buoy of the cruise ship, with a golden anchor. Hang it on the wall.
item.guhs.reisbureau_zeldzaam_cruise.lor: The life buoy of the cruise ship, with a golden anchor. Hang it on the wall.
The cheapest trip: 24 hours on your own couch. Your guh really is away for a bit, though. More or less.
book.guhs.reisbureau.kaart.balkonie: Hi boss! I am on vacation in Balconia. It looks a lot like home. The couch is the same. So is the fridge. I saw you walk by and waved, but you did not see me. Home is chonk too. Nyeg!
A guh on the couch, for 24 hours. Hang it on the wall.
item.guhs.reisbureau_souvenir_balkonie.l: A guh on the couch, for 24 hours. Hang it on the wall.
A little sign for next to the front door. Now your house is a vacation country.
item.guhs.reisbureau_zeldzaam_balkonie.l: A little sign for next to the front door. Now your house is a vacation country.
gui.guhs.reisbureau.bestemming.om_de_hoe: the little street around the corner
Five little minutes: to the corner and back. To practice leaving and coming back.
book.guhs.reisbureau.kaart.om_de_hoek: Hi boss! I am around the corner. It is almost the same as before the corner, but a bit further. I saw a pebble. I will be right back. Nyeg!
item.guhs.reisbureau_kaart_om_de_hoek: Postcard: Trial Trip Around the Corner
block.guhs.reisbureau_gouden_koffertje.l: For the true world traveler: ten stamps on your travel pass. There is nothing inside, but it shines beautifully.
item.guhs.reisbureau_gouden_koffertje.lo: For the true world traveler: ten stamps on your travel pass. There is nothing inside, but it shines beautifully.
block.guhs.reisbureau_koffertje.lore: A little suitcase covered in stickers from faraway lands. Looks cozy in the hallway.
item.guhs.reisbureau_koffertje.lore: A little suitcase covered in stickers from faraway lands. Looks cozy in the hallway.
block.guhs.guhparkour_startpaaltje.lore: Ready, set, go! ...after a little nap, Nyeg.
item.guhs.guhparkour_startpaaltje.lore: Ready, set, go! ...after a little nap, Nyeg.
block.guhs.guhparkour_startpaaltje.uitle: Click toys and obstacles with it: 1, 2, 3... up to the Finish Post. Then put it down.
block.guhs.guhparkour_finishpaaltje.lore: Whoever gets here has earned a nibble.
item.guhs.guhparkour_finishpaaltje.lore: Whoever gets here has earned a nibble.
block.guhs.guhparkour_finishpaaltje.uitl: The last piece of a Guh Parkour: the clock stops here.
block.guhs.guhparkour_horde.lore: Hup, over you go! Pulling in your tummy doesn't help.
item.guhs.guhparkour_horde.lore: Hup, over you go! Pulling in your tummy doesn't help.
block.guhs.guhparkour_horde.uitleg: Obstacle for a Guh Parkour: your guh jumps over it.
block.guhs.guhparkour_springplank.lore: Boing! For just a moment, a little chonk can fly.
item.guhs.guhparkour_springplank.lore: Boing! For just a moment, a little chonk can fly.
block.guhs.guhparkour_springplank.uitleg: Obstacle: a run-up, boing, and a long way through the air. Keep three blocks free behind it.
block.guhs.guhparkour_kruiptunnel.lore: A guh goes in and a bump travels through.
item.guhs.guhparkour_kruiptunnel.lore: A guh goes in and a bump travels through.
block.guhs.guhparkour_kruiptunnel.uitleg: Obstacle three blocks long: your guh crawls through it as a bump.
block.guhs.guhparkour_slalompaaltjes.lor: Left, right, left... which way was it again, Nyeg?
item.guhs.guhparkour_slalompaaltjes.lore: Left, right, left... which way was it again, Nyeg?
block.guhs.guhparkour_slalompaaltjes.uit: Obstacle three blocks long: zigzag between the poles.
block.guhs.guhparkour_evenwichtsbalk.uit: Obstacle three blocks long: your guh shuffles across and sometimes falls off. No worries: it climbs right back on.
block.guhs.guhparkour_knabbeltafeltje.lo: Mandatory pit stop. Eat first, run later.
item.guhs.guhparkour_knabbeltafeltje.lor: Mandatory pit stop. Eat first, run later.
block.guhs.guhparkour_knabbeltafeltje.ui: Obstacle: your guh calmly eats a nibble here first. It costs time, but it has to be done, Nyeg.
block.guhs.guhparkour_scorebord.lore: Who is the fastest little chonk in the land?
item.guhs.guhparkour_scorebord.lore: Who is the fastest little chonk in the land?
block.guhs.guhparkour_scorebord.uitleg: Shows, per guh, the laps and the best lap time of the Start Post nearby.
gui.guhs.guhparkour.hint.obstakel: This belongs to a Guh Parkour: click it with a Start Post in your hand, Nyeg.
gui.guhs.guhparkour.hint.finish: The Finish Post: click it last with your Start Post.
gui.guhs.guhparkour.niet_van_jou: This Start Post belongs to %1$s. Looking is fine, Nyeg.
gui.guhs.guhparkour.uitzet.finish: Finish added! The route has %1$s pieces. Wahoog!
gui.guhs.guhparkour.uitzet.eruit: %1$s was taken out of the route
gui.guhs.guhparkour.uitzet.vol: The route is full: a guh can't remember more than %1$s pieces, Nyeg.
gui.guhs.guhparkour.uitzet.te_ver: That is more than %1$s blocks from the start. A guh doesn't trot that far, Nyeg.
gui.guhs.guhparkour.uitzet.geplaatst: The Start Post is up! A route of %1$s pieces. Right-click to put guhs on it.
gui.guhs.guhparkour.uitzet.geplaatst_te_: The Start Post is up, with %1$s pieces. %2$s were too far away: they are left out.
gui.guhs.guhparkour.uitzet.leeg_geplaats: The Start Post is up! Sneak + right-click it, then click the pieces: 1, 2, 3...
gui.guhs.guhparkour.uitzet.modus_aan: Laying out the route: click the pieces in order (1, 2, 3...) and the Finish Post last. Clicking a piece again takes it out. Click the Start Post when you're done.
gui.guhs.guhparkour.uitzet.modus_uit: Done laying out: the route has %1$s pieces.
gui.guhs.guhparkour.rondje.record: %1$s: lap %2$s in %3$s. A new record, Wahoog!
gui.guhs.guhparkour.bord.geen_paal: This scoreboard doesn't belong anywhere yet: put it within 32 blocks of a Start Post.
gui.guhs.guhparkour.bord.gekoppeld: Scoreboard linked to the Start Post.
gui.guhs.guhparkour.bord.leeg: No laps run yet. The guhs are probably still chonking about.
gui.guhs.guhparkour.scherm.onder.klaar: Guhs run their laps until you take them off
gui.guhs.guhparkour.scherm.onder.geen_fi: No Finish Post yet: the clock now stops at the last piece
gui.guhs.guhparkour.scherm.leeg: No pieces yet. Click 'Click pieces' and then click toys and obstacles in the world: 1, 2, 3... and the Finish Post last. The slide, the seesaw, the swing and the fluffy tunnel join in too!
gui.guhs.guhparkour.scherm.geen_guhs: Pick a guh above and put it on the route.
gui.guhs.guhparkour.scherm.tip.weg: This piece is gone. Guhs skip it; take it out of the route.
gui.guhs.guhparkour.scherm.tip.hapert: A guh couldn't get here: that lap didn't count. Is something in the way?
gui.guhs.guhparkour.scherm.tip.finish: The Finish Post always stays the last piece.
gui.guhs.guhparkour.scherm.melding.op: %1$s trots to the start. Hup, little chonk!
gui.guhs.guhparkour.scherm.melding.op_le: %1$s is ready... but there is no route yet, Nyeg.
gui.guhs.guhparkour.scherm.melding.vol: Only %1$s guhs fit on a parkour at once.
gui.guhs.guhparkour.scherm.melding.gewis: All scores are wiped. A clean slate!
gui.guhs.guhparkour.gids.uitleg: Lay out a route past toys and obstacles with a Start Post and let your guhs run laps.
gui.guhs.guhparkour.gids.nog_niets: No guh has run a lap yet. Hup, Nyeg!
gui.guhs.guhparkour.gids.beste: The fastest laps of your guhs:
block.guhs.wolkenbed.hier_niet: Hier kun je niet slapen, njeg! Zelfs niet op een wolk.
guhs.configuration.title: Guhs Settings
guhs.configuration.language.tooltip: The language you read the Guhs texts in. AUTO follows the Minecraft language (Dutch for nl_nl, English for anything else); NL is always Dutch, EN always English. Only for you, also on servers. You can also switch with the language button in your Guhdex.
guhs.configuration.languageChosen.toolti: Off = the question 'Which language for Guhs?' comes once more when you join a world or server.
book.guhs.logboek626.1:
Logbook of
EXPERIMENT 626

Made by the
mad professor
Jumba-guh.
book.guhs.logboek626.2:
Goal: make the chonkiest guh ever.
So chonky that he's TOO CHONKY.

...
book.guhs.logboek626.3:
Reading 1: chonky.
Reading 2: very chonky.
Reading 3: WAHOOG.
Reading 4: the meter is broken. Nyeg?!
book.guhs.logboek626.4:
Conclusion:
A guh can never be too chonky.

INCALCULABLY WAHOOG.

(626 has escaped. He is sweet.)
book.guhs.logboek626.title: Logbook 626
